| | Fellow Patriot,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **

_But now, Fellow Patriot, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth.

And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default.

Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country.

It's up to us to finish what he started.

One chapter. One student. One school at a time.

Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love.

**P.S.** There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out...

He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning.

When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. _**We don 't have time to wait.**_**" **

And he was right.

The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers.

We may be in 13% of our schools now...

_But in the other 87%? _

The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them.

And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous."

You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it.

He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses.

And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now.

**Fellow Patriot, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- _this is it._ **

You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do.

But you can send them the tools to do it.

These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead.

All they're waiting on... is us.

**Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. **

You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back.

And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time.

And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: We're in 3,300. That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America. Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide. ✅ Florida ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee ✅ Oklahoma ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Arkansas ✅ Indiana And we're just getting started. Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country... That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom. That 's what Club America is about... Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. But now, Fellow Patriot, the question is... What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? Because here's the truth: These students aren't just signing up. They 're stepping up. They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous. But that isn't stopping them. They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever. They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, but brave. Not just loud, but principled. Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses. Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship. Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth. And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default. Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country. It's up to us to finish what he started. One chapter. One student. One school at a time. Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out... He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning. When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers. We may be in 13% of our schools now... But in the other 87%? The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them. And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous." You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it. He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses. And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now. Fellow Patriot, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- this is it. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can send them the tools to do it. These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead. All they're waiting on... is us. Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back. And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

These USPS postmark changes and Trump's delivery list are just the latest steps taken by MAGA's vote suppressors to limit mail-in ballots.
Why? Because in recent elections, the percentage of people voting by mail hasn't favored their extremist candidates, and voter participation has actually increased via the use of vote-by-mail and drop boxes. This all leads to candidates MAGA doesn't like winning elections.
Team, these changes are about who has power now and how badly they want to keep it. RUSH $35 or more right now to help inform voters of this change and defend the use of mail-in ballots across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=070826_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
HuffPost: Mail-In Voters Could Face A New Obstacle This Midterm Season [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=070826_3&amount=25]
Team: Changes at the U.S. Postal Service are going to make a known problem even worse, and it could affect thousands of voters across the country in this November’s midterm elections.
Legally speaking, the date stamped on your mail is when it counts as being sent, from your bills to your taxes to your ballot. For decades, that's been stamped the day you gave it to the United States Postal Service (USPS), whether you handed it to your mail carrier, left it in a mailbox, or dropped it at the local post office.
That's no longer the case. Your mail will be stamped the day it hits a regional processing facility , not your local post office. That could be a day, or more, later than when you handed your mail over, thanks to the Trump administration's "cost-cutting" efforts.
How does this impact vote-by-mail? If you live in a state with a mail-in ballot grace period -- something most states still have, even though MAGA is trying to end those -- your ballot still counts if it was postmarked by Election Day and received in the grace period after Election Day. In this case, however, a ballot mailed on Election Day may not be postmarked as Election Day, making your ballot automatically invalid even though you followed the rule of law and the postmark date is out of your control.
Of course, this was followed by the recent news that USPS won't deliver your ballot unless your state put your name on Trump's list -- usurping the Constitution and trying to take control of elections away from the states in order to suppress the vote.

We're worried about every mail-in voter getting their ballot in on time, but especially those most vulnerable to these changes, like the elderly, rural Americans who live far from USPS regional facilities, our military service members, and young people who are voting by mail away from home. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: What the Democratic Party is going to have to decide

body:
We can’t just be against Donald Trump. We have to be for something.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260708-6444-footer&t=1&akid=6444%2E420207%2E5fNCqG)
Peter,
Right now there’s a lot of talk about what Democrats need to do to win back power — and more importantly, what we’ll do when we actually have power.
**But to answer both of these questions, what the Democratic Party is going to have to decide is _“what do we stand for?”_**
Because we can’t just be against Donald Trump. We have to be _for_ something.
Yet even now there are already pundits, and some of my colleagues in Congress, who want to push to the center. They want us to become Trump-lite instead of articulating the vision of what we stand for on our own terms, informed by what we see in our conversations and hear on the ground and see in the data.
I couldn’t disagree more.
I believe we need to clearly stand up for our principles. We need to respond to the urgency of people’s economic concerns. And we need to offer a real contrast to the Republican Party.
**So here’s what I stand for:**
* Medicare for All.
* Living wages for all.
* Universal childcare.
* An economy that works for everyone.

And I am so proud of the progressive candidates who are standing up and saying loudly and clearly what they believe in as they run in Democratic primary elections across the country. Over the past few months, they’ve been winning races in state after state — and we need to learn from their success.
I’m going to continue using my voice to push our party to take bold action that centers the real, pressing concerns that poor and working people across this country are dealing with right now.
**But since my very first campaign, I’ve never taken a dime of corporate PAC money.** Which means I’m counting on your grassroots support to keep fighting for our progressive vision for the future.
[**So Peter, if you’re with me, can I count on you to pitch in $3 or any amount today to help power this movement?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260708.ZksDKz&refcode=em20260708-6444&amount=3&t=2&akid=6444%2E420207%2E5fNCqG)

In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP62/1/120031/images/eon%20header.png]
Team, over the last few months, I've had some time to think.
And the more I thought, the more I kept coming back to something my father used to say at the dinner table when I was growing up in Peoria.
He'd look at us and say: "Think of the greatness of this country. Whatever you do, make sure this country is there for the next families who need it."
He said that as an immigrant who came here with nothing. He said it after our family had struggled, having lived in public housing and on food stamps. He said it because he believed — with everything he had — that this country could still be a place where hard work leads somewhere. Where a kid with a hard-to-pronounce last name still gets a real shot.
I built my entire life around that belief.
And right now, that belief is under direct attack.
Donald Trump and his MAGA allies are gutting the safety net that kept my family afloat.
They're rigging the economy for billionaires while working and middle-class families fall further behind.
They're weaponizing the government against immigrants, against workers, against anyone who dares to believe the American Dream should be available to everyone — not just the powerful and well-connected.
My father's America is being dismantled piece by piece. And I refuse to sit back and watch it happen.
That's why today, I'm launching Equal Opportunity Now — a group dedicated to supporting causes and leaders who will fight like hell to expand opportunity, take on Trump's MAGA agenda, and make sure this country is still there for the next families that need it.
Equal Opportunity Now will support the fights that matter most to working families: making sure every child has food on the table and access to a quality education, lowering prescription drug costs and grocery prices, strengthening good-paying jobs and workers' rights, holding corporate bad actors and corrupt politicians accountable, and fighting bigotry and prejudice in all its forms.
These problems require ambitious, bold solutions, championed by leaders who know that our time is running out.
That's why I need you to become a founding donor of Equal Opportunity Now today.
The leaders and groups who are willing to fight back against Trump's MAGA agenda and deliver real change are out there. But they need funding, infrastructure, and people ready to invest in them early. Founding donors who step up now make it possible. They make it real.
Will you split a contribution of $10, $25, or $50 with Equal Opportunity now and Resist Reclaim Rebuild to start this organization off on the right foot? Your grassroots contribution in this early stage will be CRUCIAL to helping us win. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-eon]
CHIP IN TODAY TO DEFEAT MAGA EXTREMISM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-eon]
My father was right about this country. It's worth fighting for.
Thanks for joining me in the next chapter of my journey; it means the world to me.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi

| | Dear Faithful Friend,
This year, as we mark 250 years in this great experiment in liberty, I keep asking myself the same question: _**Are we keeping the faith?** _
Let me explain what I mean.
At the very heart of it, _we were born a nation of Christian pilgrims and dissenters. _
The Pilgrims. The Puritans. The Quakers. The Huguenots. The German Pietists. Wave after wave of men and women who crossed an ocean because they refused to let any earthly power stand between them and their biblical faith in the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob – the God revealed in Jesus Christ.
_That is the seed America grew from_ , and every time we’ve forgotten this, we’ve gone astray.
The very first freedom in the Bill of Rights – the one the framers put first, not fifth or tenth, but first – is **the freedom to worship God without interference from government**. That wasn’t random. It was the whole point.
And when people knock our founding fathers as relics of a bygone era who “wouldn’t understand the world today,” I ask you to think about our brothers and sisters in Christ today, _right now_ , in places like Nigeria, Iran, Pakistan, North Korea and many other places.
**There are an estimated 388 million Christian men, women and children being persecuted, oppressed and ruthlessly murdered simply for loving Jesus.**
Here in America, _it’s almost impossible to know what that’s like_ , but we do have the freedom, the platform and the resources to support them, and fight back in a wide range of ways. **The question is, will we?**
I can’t help but feel that this year, on the 250th birthday of the world’s most indispensable Christian nation, that we have a duty to rededicate ourselves to God and to the defense of His people around the world. **And today, I’m asking you to partner with me and an incredible organization in that endeavor.**
**There is no organization in this country more committed to that fight than Save the Persecuted Christians, where I’m proud to serve as a board member.** ** ** Whether it’s the growing awareness of the active genocide against Nigeria’s Christians (and recent U.S. action to help stop it), or the recent and very real victories against the rise of sharia and Islamism here in America, it is due in very large part to the relentless advocacy and education campaigns of Save the Persecuted Christians and the coalition of 200+ organizations they help to guide.
[ **As we commemorate America’s 250th birthday, I humbly but urgently ask that you help to supercharge their efforts with a generous, tax-deductible contribution.** ](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=56bb6eb9e2ab47dabe68a855845d905d&_e=nsHsatXi1YXpgu7-SMZ2cKJCR2jbgy1jJkh81yg4XXitG9l5dF4V3Re8SqBCwrb_NXBO92v3HPOB7C8LhijgHbzIxHVOFmdVwKhnRHdZIn_wfUkTCe-xacZLrHeugkt8BwJbS00SoEhQAEC7g0d-Bs256wv84dSXBSUC6-PkO1fO7GMHjGgMWOAwI1Fku6By7wyGQuoPIo0XaBKuBym-3i4kgs6wkzXb1a0HAEpm07DnK-lriH-dUmpb_RfsSWNhb6dX9qFvdwSvg_T3hCgSjB_Mid8rVTQBnsfvhVkM7ydueFub33aG0kFNvYzFGit1DSShDoiPLrMhRWj4cJ1ceFz98E0Qe5-IT1PZ4qi08piP4GOt_XLRYZOl3gFxGYVjgWfdqo6nxwDmHCy21YDHE7De3XJsEefwIWaC8Ybmduk6Xo6pqUkMXgYrC1YAvbEy6zOkE_evfrdcUknQ_3E_A_DjGgPkQ4-jMsPVqz0hmTwWMKtADh1nm0imhQfnimJGRUflvZs4U5M9la-p9oVLC5BW2Syy_MSr0ikkcld0qrBumVC-BeZYETVqlQ-3Kfhl0MYkMoS6ggsGjXh2y4u3rKbIb79NRwQB4hbF26aS2xWh0eShAfFqtyw-QQHPEUTpw_Ngb2nwDaLcNa0rURLjlbsNeS0W0KF3zFEh-HkoTD3NHw5D036P-ygpVS7lUunL7AfdiCjZRoWuJbIPjyXNSCT8jHUddwy62Z1-R0d7DaIomlTe3NJbLDimZ4RvzTp9)

As you contemplate your potential commitment, I ask you to think about this.
**While Christians in America today are the freest Christians in the history of the world, 388 million of our brothers and sisters, in other parts of the world, are being hunted for practicing the same faith that built this country.**
Every generation that ever mattered to the kingdom of God understood that faith without action is sentiment – and sentiment has never freed a single soul.
**Now it's our turn.**
Two hundred and fifty years ago, the founders pledged their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor. _They paid the price._ They handed us the inheritance. The only real question this year is what we do with it.
On July 3, 1776 – one day after the Continental Congress had voted to declare independence – John Adams sat down in Philadelphia and wrote to his wife Abigail.
He told her this new American holiday " _ought to be commemorated, as the Day of Deliverance, by solemn Acts of Devotion to God Almighty. It ought to be solemnized with Pomp and Parade, with Shews, Games, Sports, Guns, Bells, Bonfires and Illuminations, from one End of this Continent to the other, from this Time forward forever more._ "
Notice the order. _First solemn devotion to God._ Then the fireworks.
250 years later, we’ve kept the fireworks. But the question is, have we maintained the devotion?
I believe we still can. **This anniversary is bigger than a birthday party. It is a reckoning** – with our history, with our blessings, and with our obligations to the brothers and sisters around the world who are paying the highest possible price for the very faith we still get to practice openly.
They are praying for a Church that does not always remember their names.
On this 250th birthday – of all years – we have the chance to tell them they are not forgotten.
[ **That is what your gift does. That is what Save the Persecuted Christians does. All, ending endless wars, and taking on the oligarchs — was never about
one person. And now Our Revolution is leading the charge to get Troy
Jackson — a logger, union leader, longtime Bernie ally, and former Maine
Senate President — on the ballot in November.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

This cycle has made one thing abundantly clear, the appetite for bold,
progressive leadership is only growing.

Over the last two weeks, we’ve had tremendous wins, electing Melat Kiros
in Colorado and Darializa Avila Chevalier and Claire Valdez in New York,
making that six progressive leaders we are sending to Congress.

Now people are taking notice!

This week, The Intercept published a feature on the movement reshaping
Democratic politics. The headline says it all:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260708-2.HUQ2kW&refcode=em20260708-38002&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=38002%2E1203867%2ENmPv6q ]"There's a new Democratic machine. It's unabashedly socialist."

The article explains how organizations like Justice Democrats, alongside
our partners, are building the infrastructure to take on the political
establishment and win!

As our Communications Director said:

“Justice Democrats has the expertise to run federal challenger primaries
— embedding in campaigns as staff and advisers, managing budgets,
recruiting and training candidates, coordinating donors and leading
independent expenditure programs,”

“Combining that expertise with local DSA’s immense field and organizing
power, which is unmatched in cities like NYC, delivers these monumental
victories.”

Our victories didn't happen by accident. They happened because supporters
like you invested in recruiting bold candidates.

After Melat’s victory, our Communications Director summed up this cycle in
one sentence:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260708-2.HUQ2kW&refcode=em20260708-38002&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=38002%2E1203867%2ENmPv6q ]"We're just having an amazing fucking cycle."

We couldn’t agree more.

We are not slowing down. Every victory we celebrate today makes the
establishment more determined to stop the next one. That's why we're
already preparing for our remaining primaries in August, just a few weeks
away.

We have to keep this momentum going through November and beyond if we’re
going to finally have a government that puts the working class first.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260708-2.HUQ2kW&refcode=em20260708-38002&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=38002%2E1203867%2ENmPv6q ]Can we count on you to chip in $5 or more today to help
power our growing movement?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260708-2.HUQ2kW&refcode=em20260708-38002&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=38002%2E1203867%2ENmPv6q ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=7637%2E582294%2E83MXQZ ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=7637%2E582294%2E83MXQZ ]Chris Pappas for Senate

The ground is shifting under New England’s Senate races, and we need you
to pay attention to what it means for Chris.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260708_3.0i1CwP&refcode=em20260708-3&t=1003&akid=7637%2E582294%2E83MXQZ ]Before we explain we want to be clear: Democrats must win in New
Hampshire to have a chance to flip the Senate this fall. Rush a donation
to Chris Pappas right now >>

Over in Maine there’s real uncertainty right now about who will be on the
ballot in November’s Senate race. We’re not going to speculate on that —
it’s not our race to weigh in on.

But here’s what is certain: While everyone’s eyes are locked on Maine,
Republicans are not looking away from New Hampshire. This seat has been
one of the GOP’s top offensive targets from day one, and a distracted,
divided Democratic donor base is exactly the opening they’re waiting for.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260708_3.0i1CwP&refcode=em20260708-3&t=1004&akid=7637%2E582294%2E83MXQZ ]Don’t give them that opening. Chip in to Chris’s campaign and help hold
the line in New Hampshire today.

Here’s the math: Democrats need to hold on to every Senate seat we have
and flip four more to win back the Senate majority. New Hampshire is one
of the seats we cannot afford to lose.

With so much attention on what’s happening next door, we need to make sure
Chris’s race doesn’t slip through the cracks.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260708_3.0i1CwP&refcode=em20260708-3&t=1005&akid=7637%2E582294%2E83MXQZ ]Chip in right now. Help us lock down New Hampshire for Democrats this
year and take it out of the equation.

While our neighbors figure out their path forward, we can’t afford any

June gave us a lot to praise God for. From San Antonio to Billings, God moved through TPUSA Faith in powerful ways. Here's what happened.
## **14 Years of Turning Point USA**
This past June marked our 14th anniversary. We remembered our founder, Charlie Kirk, and honor the vision God gave him for this organization. Thank you for being part of it, and keep praying that God uses TPUSA for His glory.

Thousands of women gathered in San Antonio June 5–7 for a weekend centered on H.E.R.: holistic wellness, empowerment through biblical values, and redemption through Jesus. Erika Kirk, Noleen and Millicent Sedra, Allie Beth Stuckey, Riley Gaines, and more brought conviction and encouragement throughout the weekend.

Join us in person or online as we make Jesus known and advance His kingdom. | Take part in our Monthly Challenge! Download the graphics below and make this month's verse your phone wallpaper. Pray for God to move in this nation as He has never moved before. One last thing... Every event, every conversation, every changed life costs something. If the Lord is stirring you to give, your gift helps us reach more churches, more campuses, and more young people with a strong biblical worldview at the moment our culture needs it most. #
Meet American Conservation Hero Rosalie Edge
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_Who is she?_**
Rosalie Edge (1877–1962) was a gifted, persuasive writer and speaker who used her talents to advance both the women’s suffrage movement and wildlife conservation. She led the charge to have Washington state’s Olympic peninsula protected as a National Park, and she was involved in protecting Sequoia, Kings Canyon, Yosemite and Grand Teton National Parks as well.
#
Many of the battles Edge fought continue today: old-growth forest logging, air and water pollution and development still threaten precious wild and public lands.
#
**“The time to protect a species is while it is still common." – Rosalie Edge**
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_What animals inspired Edge?_**
Edge took up birding in her late forties and was particularly infatuated with birds of prey. Her love of raptors and efforts to help them even earned her the nickname, “the Hawk of Mercy.”
#
For instance, when she noticed the overzealous hunting of raptors that migrated each fall along [**the Kittatinny Ridge in Pennsylvania**](https://support.defenders.org/s/5733157/38SyG9Xl) , she created the first refuge for birds of prey. Today, Hawk Mountain Sanctuary is the largest member-supported raptor conservation organization in the world.
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_How can you become a conservation hero?_**
Edge’s gift for persuasive writing and speaking helped her and her companions win many fights throughout the women’s suffrage and conservation movements. You too can write and speak out directly to your community and state leaders! A published Letter to the Editor in your local paper, for example, can alert others to what’s happening on an under-represented issue or flag lopsided coverage of a topic. Find other ways you can [**become a Wildlife Defender here!**](https://support.defenders.org/s/5733158/38SyG9Xl)
#
|
---
###
_A note on our Heroes in American Conservation series: Our country has a long and complex history, populated with high-profile figures whose views may have been complicated or divisive in their time as well as ours. We present these conservationists in the interest of creating a greater understanding of the roots of the American conservation movement, and to inspire you to make your own contribution to ongoing conversations about how we preserve our wild world._

The bottom line is that when families can't make ends meet, they are forced to make serious choices. They delay medical care; stop buying healthy food in favor of cheaper, more heavily processed options; and even skip meals altogether. Ultimately, they often go further into debt. As bad as that is, the more challenging part for families near or below the poverty line is figuring out how to get out of that hole in an era of stagnating incomes, declining upward mobility, and rising costs of everyday necessities.
When asked what he would say to the 60% of Americans who live paycheck to paycheck, Rep. Troy Nehls (R-TX) said "maybe the 60% of Americans don't work as hard as I do..."
Mike Rogers has shown the same concern about the affordability crisis as he does about every issue his constituents face: he hasn't said a word about it...

[The Problem With Low Wage Companies](https://swo5c8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ck5ut48ZzWrYUA7qdBf0VJeuNTJtW2-8JHZ2cZP2AEZDvVe6uknsfPo_anGlNm1dkxVaPW0jQOt3o2QJ_T2Qb5zYM26btRSCFh9yQV57JQECInadTqh5T50GDan-h_eiD04G3XgvGsJUjMu1P9vpnfzCYgts9IP8oyfAYgAMcsdYTFa_wlKGIAJnc_KNjSkBInJgo1qRXXxeZGRua0UAjA==&c=bms9EJ_YgEqy0xCn5_a36YW6V6QPjDqpwRVCE1V4qnJ5fD6bJNq7RQ==&ch=DdTOKNFuRmVpWs5BpsjKGxjZtSt3Vugp9rqixJwgp_5w9X7KyJnoDg==)
---
In March of this year, the Institute for Policy Studies (IPS) released a report on a group of companies it referred to as the "Low Wage 20." The report examines the 20 publicly held corporations in the S&P 500 that are the largest employers of low-wage workers. It included facts like these:

* 15 of the Low-Wage 20 reported median pay in 2024 below the $35,631 income limit for a family of three to be eligible for Medicaid in most states.
* 13 of the 20 reported median pay below the $33,576 threshold for a family of three to be eligible for SNAP food aid in 2024.
* Walmart alone likely has around 468,800 employees on Medicaid.

For contrast, the average CEO salary for these companies is $18.9 billion, or 899 times the median salary of their employees.

# One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
I hope everyone had a great 4th of July. It's important to remember that while we celebrate the beginning of this experiment in democracy, we also recognize that it has not ended.
We got to visit with people in LaFayette, Heflin, and Jacksonville as they celebrated the 250th anniversary of this nation's birth. All of them were excited about the holiday, and many were eager to meet someone running to represent them. What they wanted to talk about wasn't surprising. They're worried about the cost of living. They worry about the lack of health care in their area. They're worried about the care they will receive for the injuries they suffered in service to our nation. They don't think their government cares about them.
We won't fix those problems overnight, but if we commit to continuing the American Revolution this November at the ballot box, we know things will get better.
Those in and around St. Clair County and Pell City, don't forget we have a town hall meeting on July 9. Details are on the calendar. All our town halls are open to the public, and we don't pre-screen questions.
We're 119 days away from the general election.

We'll talk soon,

Lee

clean_body: You Don't Want to Miss This | | | | | == | | | CAMPAIGN UPDATE | | | | | | == | MAKING HISTORY | | THE WEEK AHEAD | | Tallapoosa County Democratic Party Meeting 🗓️ July 7 🕓 6 P.M. 📍 175 Aliant Pkwy, Alexander City AL | | Etowah County Lee McInnis for Alabama Town Hall Featuring 3 local candidates 🗓️ July 9 🕓 6 - 8 P.M. 📍 100 Bruce Etheridge Pkwy, Pell City AL | | | Second Saturday on the Square 🗓️ July 11 🕓 9 A.M. 📍 Clay County Courthouse Square, Ashland AL | | Lanett Festival on the Square 🗓️ July 12 🕓 3 - 6:30 P.M. 📍 258 N Lanier Ave, Lanett AL | | | | | THE WEEK BEHIND | | | | | | | | | | | | We watched Hamilton on the lawn at the Gogue Center, and it was a lot of fun. Thanks to everyone who came out. We stopped by LaFayette 250. I spoke with a couple of fire fighters I had met before. They were polite until I mentioned I had dropped off cookies at the fire house and then they remembered me! I was in Heflin and Jacksonville to meet people and talk to them about the campaign. Cleburne and Calhoun Counties are great parts of this district, and it was great to see people want to engage with someone who wants to represent them in Congress. | | | | | | | | | | | | In Case You Missed It | LEE IN THE NEWS | Congressional candidate Lee McInnis to host St. Clair County Town Hall | BLOG POSTS | == The bottom line is that when families can't make ends meet, they are forced to make serious choices. They delay medical care; stop buying healthy food in favor of cheaper, more heavily processed options; and even skip meals altogether. Ultimately, they often go further into debt. As bad as that is, the more challenging part for families near or below the poverty line is figuring out how to get out of that hole in an era of stagnating incomes, declining upward mobility, and rising costs of everyday necessities. When asked what he would say to the 60% of Americans who live paycheck to paycheck, Rep. Troy Nehls (R-TX) said "maybe the 60% of Americans don't work as hard as I do..." Mike Rogers has shown the same concern about the affordability crisis as he does about every issue his constituents face: he hasn't said a word about it... | == In March of this year, the Institute for Policy Studies (IPS) released a report on a group of companies it referred to as the "Low Wage 20." The report examines the 20 publicly held corporations in the S&P 500 that are the largest employers of low-wage workers. It included facts like these: 15 of the Low-Wage 20 reported median pay in 2024 below the $35,631 income limit for a family of three to be eligible for Medicaid in most states. 13 of the 20 reported median pay below the $33,576 threshold for a family of three to be eligible for SNAP food aid in 2024. * Walmart alone likely has around 468,800 employees on Medicaid. For contrast, the average CEO salary for these companies is $18.9 billion, or 899 times the median salary of their employees. | == | A Few Things to Think About | | | ALABAMA IN THE NEWS | 📰 == A dispute among House Republicans over the SAVE America Act stalled action on the annual defense authorization bill, forcing the U.S. House to cancel votes and begin its July recess early. While Alabama Republicans supported advancing both measures together, disagreements within the GOP over how to handle the election bill brought House business to a standstill. Democrats oppose the SAVE America Act as a voter suppression measure. | 📰 == Veterans Affairs officials say many Alabama veterans are missing out on health care, disability compensation, and other earned benefits because they mistakenly believe they are ineligible or are unaware of available programs. Officials encouraged veterans to seek assistance, noting that the 2022 PACT Act has expanded eligibility for benefits related to toxic exposure and has already provided more than $300 million in benefits to Alabama veterans. | 📰 == A St. Clair County father is appealing to the public after Alabama Medicaid denied coverage for his 17-year-old daughter's surgery at a Texas hospital, a procedure her doctors say is necessary to treat an aggressive form of bone cancer before it spreads. The case raises concerns about barriers to accessing lifesaving specialty care, as the family races to raise money while seeking approval for treatment. | 📰 == Greene County has suspended its ambulance service because of a lack of funding, leaving residents to rely on neighboring counties for emergency medical response and expect significant delays. The situation highlights Alabama's broader rural health care challenges, as most counties are considered ambulance deserts and continue to struggle with shortages of emergency medical services despite recent state efforts to improve funding. | A CALL TO ACTION | Volunteer: We're building a strong volunteer team to power the campaign through the general election, and we need your help. Sign up below to help move this campaign forward. | == | Follow Us: We need you to like, comment on, and share our social media posts. We also need you to talk to your friends about the campaign. We need you to come to any events we have in your area so your friends can see they're not alone. | == == == | | | Donate: Your contribution helps us keep our campaign moving by funding outreach, events, and voter engagement efforts across the district. | | == | | One Last Thought Until Next Week | | | I hope everyone had a great 4th of July. It's important to remember that while we celebrate the beginning of this experiment in democracy, we also recognize that it has not ended. We got to visit with people in LaFayette, Heflin, and Jacksonville as they celebrated the 250th anniversary of this nation's birth. All of them were excited about the holiday, and many were eager to meet someone running to represent them. What they wanted to talk about wasn't surprising. They're worried about the cost of living. They worry about the lack of health care in their area. They're worried about the care they will receive for the injuries they suffered in service to our nation. They don't think their government cares about them. We won't fix those problems overnight, but if we commit to continuing the American Revolution this November at the ballot box, we know things will get better. Those in and around St. Clair County and Pell City, don't forget we have a town hall meeting on July 9. Details are on the calendar. All our town halls are open to the public, and we don't pre-screen questions. We're 119 days away from the general election. ## Trump Ends Ceasefire with Iran
President Trump [declared the ceasefire](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLvOnDAQRp8GOiNfuCyFizR0f9qUyLHHMImxkWd2yb59xBZ5gdRHOvrO9-Nr_XKYMG_f3QGWY1kzXJSAGerqwRFErAA50JkcZ6i7S0yrlnoUchJyXoPD9F77NtgIoMG0YNX0MMOsRvNodzsNszEyjEbGUU0_lTcuSKmk79XQawUt2tsmJzkrKSc1drMKsn945b0aBt3HppcQkEvtfhXMvENM7_KC2vlytMnuzCc15lujl0Yv13V1sfy5K27e6OUsCRk9NXrh-jxOQe5NAqvL4l-guH3CRYb6IeiycMzO_ybBFbcNqjgcEb5APElUoLNkgrbacF6YEtI4Nb3cDofpM4v_68uX1X8DAAD__wZAi58) with Iran "over" at the NATO summit in Ankara, Turkey, after the U.S. struck more than 80 Iranian targets overnight in response to attacks on three commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. The U.S. [hit Iran again Wednesday night](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLtuwyAUhp8Gb1hcfB0YUlXe0qVDR-sEDjENBgtwrLx95Q59gc6f9F--r-t8BedduH_AiqrYOAc8ssdSMM0aIaN1CTGYvHkoAdMCvuRZMNFR1lM2zgacf81NZZRFFCgrVLwfZDvyTg7VoqA17GabzloB3AAM4022WjJroDMo28qpM431bOSM9byrR25YM2iuNW9b0VjSMDSuxFR_RxfKgta_4hNTreNaebWUsmUiL0RMREzHcdRrDicjYsJA90zEdJ46YUzeEDHtmXrYg14w04AHzSW5B2YaA3UJAgVbMNGS9nWjBrWHhJn-2aBnORETJHq5iP6p84PIKWpniHx_O13ikT8xbVVSZjuc9y53PWnYfQXnf1eXf6l-KvETAAD__xz4lcA), after Trump floated the idea of reimposing a naval blockade on the strait, and suggested the U.S. could seize Kharg Island, which handles roughly 90% of Iran's oil exports. Iran retaliated by launching drone and missile strikes at U.S. military facilities in [Bahrain and Kuwait](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O5CAQhJ8GZ4yg_YMdEFzibC690GKgGfctNhb0zshvv_Jq32CTlrpK-lRV_-7L3VGi_fnXbWg55mXHd03IjGXx6CpGKoh7qEdyvGNZXeK6gIJBKiPVtARH6Vy6JtiICNg2aLUZ237SQzs2qx1w6Ho0rus9GAQclFOPOEJ8-Ak0jA3Zi6aMmrRSRg-3SQfVjV57r_seuig6hYE4l9v_TDuvGNOZX1huPm9NsivzUUX7R8AsYN7PI1e-LAHzBRYwK3OdUcD8ziUFeVUUMFNxu2RXnshVVmKscqNE7Mr58zpfcr3UEBJKdJWli4xFflZZudAHXpym2HC8KSWqgxGdem6O0nc4_tWiLwtfAQAA___htIr2). clean_body: President Trump with Iran "over" at the NATO summit in Ankara, Turkey, after the U.S. struck more than 80 Iranian targets overnight in response to attacks on three commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. | | | | | | Thursday, July 9, 2026 ---|--- Good Morning! On this day in 1922, U.S. swimmer Johnny Weissmuller set a world record by swimming the 100-meter freestyle in just 58.6 seconds, becoming the first person to swim the event in less than one minute. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | Jacob Davis's Market Brief (ads) | • | Anchor Point Research ---|--- • | Salem Media Group • | Brownstone Research | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. Saturday we celebrated the 250th anniversary of our country's founding| | | |
---
# 250 Years Towards a More Perfect Union
---
| | | _To our Friends and Supporters, _ It’s hard to believe we’re already in mid-summer with a whole roster of dairy breakfasts and parades behind us, and months more of special events and summer parades ahead. Our volunteer turnout at these events has only grown week to week and we’ve been proud to see the Clark for Wisconsin Team fielding the largest and most enthusiastic groups of volunteers of any candidate!
---
| | |
---
| | | It’s true that parades don’t vote, but the message our volunteers can send to thousands of residents and visitors along parade routes is one of the strongest visuals we have about the enthusiasm behind this campaign. For those of you, friends and supporters, who have shown up - THANK YOU! You are making a difference. And if you’re curious and want to join the fun, please see details below - we have lots more opportunities! Take a ride with our Clark for Wisconsin team in [this video compilation](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134905517/632570985/-2141824314?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjEwMzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjllNDEyNTktODU3Yi1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mxqZNhYRrhqwzPxMlTRi8fmHhcb2lbgDxBFjfRZ52xw=&emci=0dc98adb-1377-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&emdi=69e41259-857b-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=28718937) from the Ashland Independence Day Parade. As the Boss always says, 'We Take Care of our Own!'
---
| | |
---
---
| |
---
---
| | | I also took some time prior to Independence Day to reflect on what 250 years of the American Experiment feels like today, and what it felt like to me as a 17 year old in 1976. In those years, even with so many challenges, we still basically seemed to agree that America was destined to continue making progress. But today it seems many Americans don’t share the same trust or the same optimism we enjoyed 50 years ago. With help from our videographer Barron Whitet, I shared more thoughts and images on [Independence Day 1976 and 2026 in this short video.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134905519/632570986/-1275376919?si=U2vGY7pNV8cn_HXj&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjEwMzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjllNDEyNTktODU3Yi1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mxqZNhYRrhqwzPxMlTRi8fmHhcb2lbgDxBFjfRZ52xw=&emci=0dc98adb-1377-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&emdi=69e41259-857b-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=28718937) As we get closer to the August 11th primary election, our whole team has been encouraged by the [outpouring of support and a growing list of endorsements](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134905521/632570987/584913326?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjEwMzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjllNDEyNTktODU3Yi1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mxqZNhYRrhqwzPxMlTRi8fmHhcb2lbgDxBFjfRZ52xw=&emci=0dc98adb-1377-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&emdi=69e41259-857b-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=28718937). But none of them have left us feeling as energized and hopeful as receiving an endorsement this week from former **Wisconsin 7th CD Representative David Obey**. David Obey represented Northern Wisconsin in Congress from 1969 - 2011. He holds the distinction of being the second longest-serving member and the longest serving Democrat in the United States House of Representatives from Wisconsin.
---
| | |
---
| | | I am deeply honored to have received David's endorsement and look forward to helping continue the work he committed himself to for so many years. Finally, please note that we’re just over 30 days away from the August 11th primary election. In this primary election we have seven qualified Democratic candidates for Wisconsin Governor, and an important choice among three Democrats running in the 7th Congressional District. YOUR vote matters very much, and many people have already voted early. I would appreciate your vote! Please make sure you are registered to vote, and make your plan to vote on August 11th, or to vote early in person or by absentee ballot. Most people I know today are still longing for faith and unity in America that they haven’t experienced in a while. And if enough of us share that hope and are ready to act on those beliefs, then I’m confident that our future as a country can still be strong. If that’s not a reason to celebrate and to get involved I don’t know what is.This is the year for change. Thank You for being part of it!
---
| | |
---
Fred
---
|
---
# ** _On the Road_**
---
| | | **Sawyer County Dairy Breakfast ** The Sawyer County Dairy Breakfast Saturday was a perfect summer morning and Team Clark showed up in force. While a few other candidates showed up to shake some hands, our team got to work all morning helping serve food and clear tables along with Sawyer County 4H kids and local Farm Bureau members. One of the things Fred loves most about working dairy breakfasts is the chance to hear from so many people and learn their passions and life stories, and what they expect out of their representatives in Congress. Also, who doesn’t love dairy?
---
| |
---
| | | **At the Red Cliff Powwow**Fred’s Independence Day weekend began on July 3rd right up the road at the Red Cliff Tribal powwow. After the Grand Entry, at the invitation of Tribal Chair Nicole Boyd, Fred was also honored to say a few words to the crowd about our upcoming elections. Powwows are an opportunity for tribal communities to come together, share traditions, food, music and dancing, to celebrate achievements, and to recognize losses.
---
---
---
| |
---
Everyone is welcome at a Pow Wow, including non-tribal neighbors and visitors. You'll smile, learn some things, eat wonderful food, meet new people, and appreciate the importance of culture and tradition for our native peoples. That same spirit can inspire all of us as we celebrate American Independence Day.
---
| | |
# **In the News**
---
| | | **Where’s Alfonso** For almost two months, Fred’s campaign has attempted to reach Michael Alfonso’s campaign via phone and email, to schedule a debate after Alfonso accepted Fred’s challenge. This after Alfonso said a bald-faced lie that Fred hates the 2nd amendment, despite being a known gun-owner and hunter. For two months Fred’s team received no response. Alfonso has also refused to appear alongside his Republican primary opponents, causing at least one frustrated organizer to stage an empty chair as a stand-in to represent him. Young people starting their careers, families looking for more space, and seniors hoping to downsize are all facing the same challenge: there simply aren't enough affordable homes available, and the homes that are on the market are often priced out of reach. Recently, a rare bipartisan effort to address the nation's housing shortage passed Congress with overwhelming support, but the legislation has been delayed after President Trump canceled the signing ceremony and tied the bill to unrelated legislation. Here in the Northwoods, we’re left shaking our heads. Everyone deserves the chance to build a future in the community they call home. We need leaders who are willing to work across the aisle to increase housing supply, invest in our communities, and make the dream of homeownership attainable again. | | | **Do You Have a Plan to Vote?** As you all probably know, we have a primary election on Tuesday, August 11th! We are confident that with your support, we will pass through the primary and use the momentum to carry us to November. But to ensure a smooth election day, we want to provide you with all the information you need to create a plan to vote. The deadline to register to vote online or by mail is July 22nd. The deadline to register at your local clerk’s office is August 7th by 5pm. And, as always, you can register to vote at your polling location on election day. To check if you are registered, you can go to myvote.wi.gov. By entering your name and birthday, you can find your registration status and polling location, and request an absentee ballot.August 6th is the deadline for requesting an absentee ballot for most individuals. A completed ballot can be mailed anytime before election day, and it is recommended to afford seven days before election day for your ballot to arrive. Your best bet is to drop it off in-person if you are able. In-person absentee (early) voting runs from July 28th through August 9th. You can drop your ballot off or fill one out at your municipal clerk’s office, or at another designated in your town. Check myvote.wi.gov for precise locations for early voting.For the full list of deadlines, check myvote.wi.gov/en-us/Voter-Deadlines. Voting is best done early and with a plan in mind. By voting, you are participating in your democracy, and exercising a right so rare in the history of humanity. Each vote cast is a quiet commitment to our republic, and an act of personal courage and patriotism. Let’s go win this election together!

clean_body: Saturday we celebrated the 250th anniversary of our country's founding| | | | 250 Years Towards a More Perfect Union | | | To our Friends and Supporters, It’s hard to believe we’re already in mid-summer with a whole roster of dairy breakfasts and parades behind us, and months more of special events and summer parades ahead. Our volunteer turnout at these events has only grown week to week and we’ve been proud to see the Clark for Wisconsin Team fielding the largest and most enthusiastic groups of volunteers of any candidate! | | | | | | It’s true that parades don’t vote, but the message our volunteers can send to thousands of residents and visitors along parade routes is one of the strongest visuals we have about the enthusiasm behind this campaign. For those of you, friends and supporters, who have shown up - THANK YOU! You are making a difference. And if you’re curious and want to join the fun, please see details below - we have lots more opportunities! Take a ride with our Clark for Wisconsin team in from the Ashland Independence Day Parade. As the Boss always says, 'We Take Care of our Own!' | | | | | | | | I also took some time prior to Independence Day to reflect on what 250 years of the American Experiment feels like today, and what it felt like to me as a 17 year old in 1976. In those years, even with so many challenges, we still basically seemed to agree that America was destined to continue making progress. But today it seems many Americans don’t share the same trust or the same optimism we enjoyed 50 years ago. With help from our videographer Barron Whitet, I shared more thoughts and images on As we get closer to the August 11th primary election, our whole team has been encouraged by the . But none of them have left us feeling as energized and hopeful as receiving an endorsement this week from former Wisconsin 7th CD Representative David Obey. David Obey represented Northern Wisconsin in Congress from 1969 - 2011. He holds the distinction of being the second longest-serving member and the longest serving Democrat in the United States House of Representatives from Wisconsin. | | | | | | I am deeply honored to have received David's endorsement and look forward to helping continue the work he committed himself to for so many years. Finally, please note that we’re just over 30 days away from the August 11th primary election. In this primary election we have seven qualified Democratic candidates for Wisconsin Governor, and an important choice among three Democrats running in the 7th Congressional District. YOUR vote matters very much, and many people have already voted early. I would appreciate your vote! Please make sure you are registered to vote, and make your plan to vote on August 11th, or to vote early in person or by absentee ballot. Most people I know today are still longing for faith and unity in America that they haven’t experienced in a while. And if enough of us share that hope and are ready to act on those beliefs, then I’m confident that our future as a country can still be strong. If that’s not a reason to celebrate and to get involved I don’t know what is.This is the year for change. Thank You for being part of it! | | | Fred | On the Road | | | Sawyer County Dairy Breakfast The Sawyer County Dairy Breakfast Saturday was a perfect summer morning and Team Clark showed up in force. While a few other candidates showed up to shake some hands, our team got to work all morning helping serve food and clear tables along with Sawyer County 4H kids and local Farm Bureau members. One of the things Fred loves most about working dairy breakfasts is the chance to hear from so many people and learn their passions and life stories, and what they expect out of their representatives in Congress. Also, who doesn’t love dairy? | | | | | At the Red Cliff PowwowFred’s Independence Day weekend began on July 3rd right up the road at the Red Cliff Tribal powwow. After the Grand Entry, at the invitation of Tribal Chair Nicole Boyd, Fred was also honored to say a few words to the crowd about our upcoming elections. Powwows are an opportunity for tribal communities to come together, share traditions, food, music and dancing, to celebrate achievements, and to recognize losses. | | Everyone is welcome at a Pow Wow, including non-tribal neighbors and visitors. You'll smile, learn some things, eat wonderful food, meet new people, and appreciate the importance of culture and tradition for our native peoples. That same spirit can inspire all of us as we celebrate American Independence Day. | | | In the News | | | Where’s Alfonso For almost two months, Fred’s campaign has attempted to reach Michael Alfonso’s campaign via phone and email, to schedule a debate after Alfonso accepted Fred’s challenge. This after Alfonso said a bald-faced lie that Fred hates the 2nd amendment, despite being a known gun-owner and hunter. For two months Fred’s team received no response. Alfonso has also refused to appear alongside his Republican primary opponents, causing at least one frustrated organizer to stage an empty chair as a stand-in to represent him. When the two candidates met at a dairy breakfast on Saturday, Michael only offered a vague suggestion for an August debate that his people would arrange. Vague offers for possible future commitments are not what voters deserve! It’s clear Michael is not ready to debate candidates for either party, even when he’s made a commitment. If Michael wants to serve in Congress, it’s past time for him to answer questions and share his beliefs and qualifications to represent Northern Wisconsin. Our new website, “Where’s Alfonso” is seeking help from residents of the 7th Congressional District in getting Alfonso to live up to his word and hold a debate - any debate! Your support for our campaign is important! Can you help us keep an eye on Michael Alfonso? It’s time for the serious candidates for Congress to stand up and be counted. | | | | | | Housing Bill Debacle For too many families in Wisconsin, the dream of owning a home is slipping further and further out of reach. Young people starting their careers, families looking for more space, and seniors hoping to downsize are all facing the same challenge: there simply aren't enough affordable homes available, and the homes that are on the market are often priced out of reach. Recently, a rare bipartisan effort to address the nation's housing shortage passed Congress with overwhelming support, but the legislation has been delayed after President Trump canceled the signing ceremony and tied the bill to unrelated legislation. Here in the Northwoods, we’re left shaking our heads. Everyone deserves the chance to build a future in the community they call home. We need leaders who are willing to work across the aisle to increase housing supply, invest in our communities, and make the dream of homeownership attainable again. That's the kind of leadership Fred will bring to Congress. | | | | | | Watch the Democratic Primary Debate! Next Tuesday, on July 14th, Fred will participate in a debate alongside his fellow Democrats. The debate will be broadcast live on WJFW NBC 12. If you are out of their TV market, you can find a link to a livestream through NBC 12’s Facebook page . Fred is fired up and ready to share his vision for governing with his fellow Northerners. If you can, tune in and show your support! | | | | | | Join Us for a Good Old Fashioned Phone Bank We will hold biweekly phone banking sessions on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 6-7pm. These sessions will also teach you how to conduct a phone bank if you are new to it. If you already know how to phone bank, please join us and we will get you started on making calls for Fred. Register for zoom or register for in-person at 423 E Pine Street, Washburn WI (Tuesdays only). | | | | | | | | | Do You Have a Plan to Vote? As you all probably know, we have a primary election on Tuesday, August 11th! We are confident that with your support, we will pass through the primary and use the momentum to carry us to November. But to ensure a smooth election day, we want to provide you with all the information you need to create a plan to vote. The deadline to register to vote online or by mail is July 22nd. The deadline to register at your local clerk’s office is August 7th by 5pm. And, as always, you can register to vote at your polling location on election day. To check if you are registered, you can go to myvote.wi.gov. By entering your name and birthday, you can find your registration status and polling location, and request an absentee ballot.August 6th is the deadline for requesting an absentee ballot for most individuals. A completed ballot can be mailed anytime before election day, and it is recommended to afford seven days before election day for your ballot to arrive. Your best bet is to drop it off in-person if you are able. In-person absentee (early) voting runs from July 28th through August 9th. You can drop your ballot off or fill one out at your municipal clerk’s office, or at another designated in your town. Check myvote.wi.gov for precise locations for early voting.For the full list of deadlines, check myvote.wi.gov/en-us/Voter-Deadlines. Voting is best done early and with a plan in mind. By voting, you are participating in your democracy, and exercising a right so rare in the history of humanity. Each vote cast is a quiet commitment to our republic, and an act of personal courage and patriotism. ## ICE Officer Fatally Shoots Houston Man
An ICE officer [shot and killed a man](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO2yAURp8Gb1gXDMEMDF28pWtHC5uLjUogMjd28vZV-gr__Emfzjl_7vPdp5zK9ts_0NE71rng1TIS4TETYmmv40wntpy2nUoqW6MjzRLkjYPhYOfgU_7MqgtugWBFh06YcdBWWSG63Rmlo5Q6jD7igkqCteCj1yZGDDDKLrnvGRiwQoDQol-U1jZaoxcA0HplCjAkqkdPOxK-fYv5U088-rU-uux2omdjwy8mJyan67r6v3t9fUcmJ39QWjMyOX29mJxyXX1mctrrq1EtPKAP-cPTitxvWIi3vVZKZWNykqPmaOKIwS8coxFcBRy4N2rkdhiW9TbAqPTQHS48r5RzajfDFGwPn_J_OvpZ09PJfwEAAP__tLCKPQ) during a targeted enforcement operation in Houston's East End Tuesday morning, federal officials said. ICE said Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, a Mexican national in the country illegally, [rammed an ICE vehicle](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAURb8GNqNnB0M8eOjClq4dkcEPeKqxI_sFkr-vUvUPul5dXd1zvm7jzVGguH66HS0_lzRGPEtAZswjI8byyAcdWAKtG0eKa-FMowLVCegFmNE7Cq-xrb2dwBtZo5X99aJNa6SsN-sQTOdbJRczXxRAp5Wf8eqlnLzvEGqy7zHowUgJUstmarU2i-n1BABaz1UL6IlTbnhDxqcrS3ilA3Mzp70OdmO-l-ryUamhUsN5ns2Snqrb0qNwiu9SpYY3VaWGv1CULSWmuIrdRfFNIaAXNKNIy0IzZhHRZTG76IIonBFZnO5VyKPwmQ6ss_X3k0Kg0vVVC-vuKPze4f9JPKz6CQAA___KS4oo) near Canal Street and Wayside Drive around 6:50 a.m., ignored commands, and tried to run over an officer, who "fired his weapon in self-defense." The man was taken to Ben Taub Hospital, where he died. The man's son, Ronaldo Salgado, said his father was a construction worker who had [lived in the U.S. for nearly 35 years](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkb2O5CAMgJ-GdIyADfkpUlyTbq-9MnLAJNYSGIFnsnn7U073BttY-iTLnz75z-fyCRQpbb_hwIm_Q14SnjUiM5aFEVN9lTe9sUbadk6UtsqFFqNMJ1Uv1bh4oHgtbeOnVflRNzjpfviwYztq3eyTccPqxsF3duhbFToNA4QBrGp7E5TvGpruY6pXo9ZKW_1YW2vHMPZ2VUpZ60Sr0BPn8uAdGb-hhnjlN5aHy0cTp535WcXHL2FmYebzPB8ukvsye35VzuneEma-s4SZY3YQhZlvpzCz6u8xCDMHOChe0uXjeCXiS0YEj6VKjwckLyHV80YIjEWSQ5lDIIdFBmCI8ZJ1z5mrPCBJSvK__eYt5Uggn1C-ZELa9jWXPWcvzNyUyT9PipFq14tWbQdQ_NfFP_vGezJ_AwAA__-ED6JZ), was pursuing a work permit, and was picking up his crew when he was shot. The League of United Latin American Citizens (LULAC) and several Houston officials [called for an independent investigation](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2u3CAUBOCnwR0rwGCHgiKNu5s2pcXPsY2EYcU567379pHzCrcezafR_P1av3wuue5__AmOvre2VnhjASLoKwFUfPUrX4Al7wfVXHeknlcl1MTFzIVdk8_ls-ohuSCSlQM4Of8ajdVWyuFwdoRkQhAmxEmrbQwmGGUnqyBCmowesrsxMQsrpZBGPoI2xm52NkEIYUxkWkDK1PqDDiD49riVT7ugP2I7h-IOoiey8TdTC1OLD1GOd8LU8mxITC3RV184UgcgjkdrlOvOz1eh_CzAi39zqFvrEU6oxP0OlZCXFn3hGyTodztCBX76egPEwSPxo72QWuXHljj6DzK1SKsnI2bJ1DJ0l57vXErGaWZa7KfP5f9k-tnRl1P_AgAA__8sb5UK), noting witness photos appeared to show no damage to the van. The DHS inspector general is investigating the shooting, and the FBI is investigating a potential assault on a federal officer.
## Abbott Orders Hospital 'Birth Tourism' Investigation
Gov. Greg Abbott on Tuesday directed the Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) to [investigate Mission Regional Medical Center](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2upSAUhZ9GOwwg_lBQTGN3p53SIGxx5yKcwB495-0nzivcbiUr-bLW9-dr_bIYMYXf9gRD7z2vCe4agQjKSgCp_i0XXlAjhoMSplCp4Cq5HBmfGNertxg_q2q92bjXogUjprkftNJCtIfZZzc6P09q1ruYQfROWbF7IfrZj0r6Fs0D4xPXQnAxiG5Tw6B3PQ0b53wYXKM4eKRcOjqA4G3rHj_5gtK5fLbRHESv2vS_Grk0crnvu_t-2_SUjVyeN41c7LZlIuaxgKPKMF1QCYMlzInlxE6s9YkFAuZkIzvBo7OROUgEhe25MBsjBPBsw0IHe1n3bQM88LYY_7oxRqzj1CgeTovx_zj6mdLLyH8BAAD__3Ybjx4) over reports it advertised "birth packages" to foreign nationals. In a letter to HHSC, Abbott said the Hidalgo County hospital marketed "Birth Packages in South Texas" in foreign countries to [profit from birth tourism](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSozAQRL8GMlGSQHAECi4h86UXUhIMYmqFRGnG2P77LXs_YeN-1dX9_t_mm8OIKfxzB1h-bnlO8KAIzFBmBkh0LxdeQBHDzglTIC44a6l7IQchx3l1GF9zV6_Wy3VUNVg1_GnN2I1K1bttjVemhQGkVv3SK79tg27d2vat9F73Ndp3mRzkqJRURjW-M2bcxsF4KaUxS9VJWJFzaXgHhqejLb7yBaVZ8lFHuzOfVLV_Kz1Vegr5aj5QE_JV6el9p9LTmYl_UigpF-G8z8xixQILk9h3WgRngekCYgyOQXgsvAvO94J0iNMtXy4AvaktF8CQRHKMOblIdbHr-cAYkfqh6mQ4HMbPPP6d1Mvq7wAAAP__VKaQKQ). "_American citizenship is not for sale, and Texas will not permit our healthcare system to be used as a magnet for birth tourism_ ," he wrote. The agency must refer any violations to Attorney General Ken Paxton for civil enforcement and to local prosecutors for potential criminal charges. The hospital said it doesn't "support or facilitate any unlawful activity" and that the [maternity marketing materials are no longer in use](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOiPbD-O4cLENXbbdEhkYYCRjR54Bkr9fkV94_dHRveffc3gGjJjWv2EHz-8lDwkuisAMZWCAREc58QSKuG6cMK3EBQctdSekFdINc8D4Gdp69qOcnarBK_v4Ma51StWbH60b7dxNJiyPLjhtQ6fCtOip00o9dFejv2XSSqeUVEY1Y2uMW5w1o5TSmKlqJczIuTS8AcM70BI_-YTSTHmvo9-YX1T9_Kl0X-n-uq5myW8bDmJMN1Lp_v5U6Z7ywZv4KsSW6YUcojjSDEVgOoEY18CYkyAODGLEcuP5KEi7oGmDHeri59eFMSJ1tmrlugeM3yH8u3yn1_8DAAD__-G-iJ0). ## Teen Survives Bedroom Lightning Strike

I told you so
A few months ago, my neighbor Mark (not his real name) came pounding on my front door like the world was ending.

I opened it, but before I could even say hello, he blurted out:

"Have you BEEN to the grocery stores?!"

He looked panicked.

"The storm hit, everybody's freaking out, people are panic-buying everything and shelves are EMPTY. You need to go NOW before there's nothing left."

I just looked at him and said:

"I'm good."

That answer hit him like gasoline on a fire.

"What do you mean you're GOOD?" he snapped. "There's no food left!"

"I'm good," I repeated calmly.

Now he looked angry... and confused.

"Dude," he said, "didn't you hear what I just said?"

I didn't really want to explain myself.

But he kept pushing.

Finally, I sighed and said:

"Mark... remember that HOA meeting a few years back?"

His expression changed instantly.

"You overheard me talking to another neighbor about the emergency food kits I bought for my family."

I paused.

"And you called me an idiot. Said I sounded like some conspiracy theorist."

Immediately, he started backpedaling.

"I never said–"

Then he stopped cold.

Because he remembered.

I watched his face change right in front of me.

The confidence disappeared.

His shoulders sank.

And quietly, almost embarrassed, he said:

"... I did say that."

Neither of us spoke for a few seconds.

Then he looked me dead in the eye and said:

"Man, I was wrong. I'm sorry."

I nodded.

"Mark, the reason I'm not panicking right now is simple..."

"I prepared before everyone else did."

"While people were laughing, I quietly made sure my family would be okay no matter what happened."

I told him we had months of emergency food stored away.

Enough to feed my entire family.

No panic.

No stress.

No fighting crowds.

No wondering how we'd survive if things got worse.

You could tell the whole experience rattled him, and I could see he was already thinking about his wife and kids.

The fear in his voice was gone now.

Before he left, he asked me to send him the exact food kits we trusted for our family.
