**Can Robots Replace Children?**_The greatest cost of depopulation is not economic. It is civilizational._ By Bobby Jindal & Alex Castellanos
---
Good news, everyone. We may not need children after all. That’s the comforting conclusion one could draw from a growing body of economic research on declining birthrates. Yes, fertility is falling. Yes, populations are aging. Yes, workforces are shrinking. But don’t worry. Artificial intelligence, robotics, and automation will make each remaining worker so much more productive that the economy will keep humming along just fine. In fact, a recent paper by Nobel laureate Daron Acemoglu and his colleagues concludes that shrinking populations have historically increased output per worker enough to offset the economic drag of having fewer workers. Productivity rises. GDP survives. Crisis averted. It’s an important finding. It may even be right. But it answers only the smallest of the questions before us. Economists have asked whether we can continue producing enough with fewer people. They should also ask what happens when there are fewer people to buy, build, dream, invent, marry, raise families, volunteer in churches, coach Little League, start companies, and imagine tomorrow. They may have solved the supply equation. The harder question is whether they’ve forgotten the demand side. And the human side. body:
Is their longevity secret drinking chocolate?
---

_**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Free Speech Daily_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily_ _._
---
| Untitled Document
There's an indigenous group of people called the Kuna in Panama that are a fascinating story in longevity as well as stellar cardiovascular health, and lack of metabolic diseases like Diabetes, etc.

The Kuna people drink an average of 5 cups of a type of cocoa every day and they have 9x lower rates of cardiovascular problems than the rest of the world.

High blood pressure is also almost non-existent in these people, yet they actually consume a good amount of salt.

And cancer rates are an astonishing 15x lower than the rest of the world. And they don't eat much leafy green vegetables either like most Americans try to stuff down.

They also consume a fair amount of sugar, yet their arteries are clean as a whistle, and blood sugar and blood pressure are normal and healthy.

But researchers found that it's NOT their genetics, because members who moved to cities and started eating modern processed foods suffered all the same health problems as most of the world (Diabetes, obesity, heart disease, etc).

In today's article, you'll find out the Kuna's longevity secrets, and what exact type of cocoa they drink that could be a huge part of their incredible health...

> [The Kuna drink 5 cups of a type of a cacao drink daily](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MzJ9AAwAAAAAAag-FPcQs4AIbh9Vm4U0ivXSZV4Loj08T7vj5Uzxn4mrYzfM2ylg0rCw4nZcZdiiWeQkSvZ76NmyVYRqpWr6aZJjhDSAA5alAph6) (and they have clean arteries, 9x lower heart disease rates, and healthy blood pressure and blood sugar)

This type of cacao they drink has also been shown to have up to 63x the antioxidant levels of broccoli and kale.

These particular flavanols (a type of polyphenol) in this type of cacao are shown in studies to improve heart health, lower blood pressure, boost blood flow throughout the body, improve blood sugar, and even improve your gut health by diversifying your microbiome.

Even more exciting is that the article will show you a study where cacao drinkers had nearly DOUBLE the levels of GLP-1 in their body within 2 hours of drinking cacao than people that didn't drink the cacao.

And as you know, GLP-1 in your body can help you slim down faster, so this is also a really cool benefit of drinking cacao, but strength and polyphenol levels matter as you'll see below...

[Read this article to see the type of cacao](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MzJ9AAwAAAAAAag-FPcR4sVEvkk4SPLEoHtu0y3JyUgnFi-PnAUJB3F3kqibknZ0zosNYqHEgg9kLe_pwOhYIga3p0bjTJSmtpHqNqo-s5gfJc1Y) that has all of these powerful benefits. Hint: It's NOT your average grocery store cocoa.

Every subscription helps us reach further, build something lasting, and keep these urgent conversations alive. We'd love to have you with us. Just $8/month makes a huge difference:](https://substack.com/redirect/8317c214-f78d-4b94-b683-3f90f81e8634?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_

* * *
Graham Platner suspended his campaign yesterday. He will not be the Democratic nominee for Senate in Maine. Good. He's a tremendous scumbag, and I believe the credible accusations of sexual assault against him.
I've spent the last week in New York doing what feels like every cable news show in existence talking about this, and I don't want to relitigate the story itself. It's been talked to death, plenty of it by me. What I want to talk about is wha t happens _around_ stories like this -- the thing that's actually broken.
Because every time one of these scandals breaks, everybody sprints to claim the moral high ground. Republicans jumped in immediately: _Democrats backed the guy with the Nazi tattoo, and now he 's a rapist. The Democratic Party is evil._ And Democrats sprinted right back: _Donald Trump has been credibly accused of abuse by dozens of women. He 's in the Epstein files._ Back and forth, forever, like a tennis match nobody wins.
I played my part in it this week. I had a clip go extremely viral from Fox News where I pointed out that Max Miller -- a sitting Republican member of Congress from Ohio -- has been accused of beating his wife and throwing a pot of boiling water on her chest in front of their kids. Fox had no answer to that. None.
And look, I'll say it plainly: I'm not going to be lectured by the Republican Party. That party is _filled_ with these people, and they know it.
But here's the thing I need to be honest about, and I need you to sit with it too: **the moral high ground doesn 't exist.** Neither party has it. Not on this.
Too many Democrats looked away from who Graham Platner was and what Graham Platner had done -- because he was saying the right things on the economy, and because people thought he was going to win. That's just true. It's exactly the same reason too many Republicans look away from Trump, or Max Miller, or Ken Paxton, an absolute scumbag who's their Senate candidate in Texas. They look away because they think these men can win. Let's stop pretending otherwise. Winning became the ethic, and everything else became negotiable.
It's wrong when they do it. It was wrong when we did it.
And it's not like Platner is some one-off. I was one of the first people to call for Eric Swalwell to resign from Congress, and I believed he had to get out of the governor's race the moment those accusations became clear. But these things should have been handled forever ago. There are predators inside the Democratic Party. Inside the Republican Party. In Congress, in lobbying firms, in consulting firms. They are everywhere. And they have all got to fucking go.
This is why I keep saying -- especially about the Epstein files -- that none of this is a partisan issue for me. I don't want to score points. I want the creeps out of our government and out of our politics. Release all the files. Prosecute every single person who trafficked and abused kids -- Democrat, Republican, or otherwise. If there are Democrats in those files, and we know there are, prosecute the shit out of them. I do not care what letter is next to their name.
####

* * *
I don't believe women because it's politically advantageous. I believe women because it's the right fucking thing to do. When women put their lives, their bodies, and their finances on the line to tell the truth about the men who abused them, I want to hear those stories. I want to weigh them seriously. And I want the abusers gone. It doesn't matter if it's Christine Blasey Ford telling her truth about Brett Kavanaugh, who sits on the Supreme Court today. It doesn't matter if it's the women who bravely came forward about Eric Swalwell, or the women who called out Graham Platner. All of these creeps have to go.
So here's my ask -- of everybody in politics, in the media, and honestly of myself:
Stop pretending there's moral superiority to claim. There isn't. Everybody, at some point, has failed to live up to our highest ideals on this. Every party, every institution, and plenty of us as individuals. The reductive back-and-forth -- the _your guy 's worse than my guy_ game, the shouting about Trump on cable news as if that settles anything -- it's a way of avoiding the tough conversation, not having it.
What we should be doing instead is simple, and hard. Have the tough conversations, including about our own side, _especially_ about our own side. Create the conditions for women to come forward knowing they'll be safe, protected, and believed -- not weaponized in somebody's news cycle and then discarded. And commit, actually commit, to exposing and removing the abusers inside our parties, our politics, and our government, whether their name is Graham Platner or Max Miller or anybody else.
Because at the end of the day, this isn't a game. There are women all over this country who are too afraid to step forward, who don't have platforms, who will never get justice against the men who hurt them -- and who relive that trauma every single time we turn one of these stories into a partisan scoreboard.
I'm ashamed of the part I've played in that game. We've all got to do better. Let's start now.

body:
Republicans don’t care about making life any easier for you |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134941494/632663488/1425818251?sourceid=1059428&refcode=WUEFES19_20260709_JulySaveAct_ALL_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNGY2NWNhMi1hZjdiLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ol5gRzeTi20x0N_59ZwIIgE6rynKGfTW7oOYeKbZtX0=) Peter,

Republicans have made their priorities clear.

They’re not interested in lowering costs for working families. They don’t care about making housing more affordable, or healthcare more accessible. Instead of making your life easier, their priority is _making it harder for you to vote._

MAGA Republicans in the U.S. House don’t even want to consider other legislation until they pass the dangerous, anti-democratic SAVE Act — because it’s what Donald Trump wants them to do. They’re ready to force it through the House floor in a budget reconciliation package _as soon as this month._

**[Peter, Republicans won’t stop until they’ve turned Trump’s radical voter suppression agenda into law. That’s why it’s more important than ever to support the EMILYs List women running to fight for their communities, defend our freedoms, and hold MAGA Republicans accountable:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134941497/632663490/1425818251?sourceid=1059428&refcode=WUEFES19_20260709_JulySaveAct_ALL_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNGY2NWNhMi1hZjdiLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ol5gRzeTi20x0N_59ZwIIgE6rynKGfTW7oOYeKbZtX0=)** | [CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134941498/632663492/1425818251?sourceid=1059428&refcode=WUEFES19_20260709_JulySaveAct_ALL_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNGY2NWNhMi1hZjdiLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ol5gRzeTi20x0N_59ZwIIgE6rynKGfTW7oOYeKbZtX0=)
---

The SAVE Act would create new roadblocks preventing millions of eligible Americans from exercising their constitutional right to vote. It would require voters to present government documents to vote — even though millions of U.S. citizens don't have easy access to their birth certificate or passport.

And millions of Americans whose names don't match those documents — including married partners who’ve taken their spouse’s name and members of the LGBTQ+ community who have changed their name — would have to jump through even more hoops.

**This is voter suppression, plain and simple. And that’s Republicans’ goal.**

House Republicans were elected to give their constituents a voice in Congress, not to ignore their struggles in order to please Donald Trump. That’s why we’re supporting the EMILYs List women running to unseat MAGA extremists and take back power.

clean_body: Republicans don’t care about making life any easier for you | = Peter, Republicans have made their priorities clear. They’re not interested in lowering costs for working families. They don’t care about making housing more affordable, or healthcare more accessible. Instead of making your life easier, their priority is making it harder for you to vote. MAGA Republicans in the U.S. House don’t even want to consider other legislation until they pass the dangerous, anti-democratic SAVE Act — because it’s what Donald Trump wants them to do. They’re ready to force it through the House floor in a budget reconciliation package as soon as this month. = | = The SAVE Act would create new roadblocks preventing millions of eligible Americans from exercising their constitutional right to vote. It would require voters to present government documents to vote — even though millions of U.S. citizens don't have easy access to their birth certificate or passport. And millions of Americans whose names don't match those documents — including married partners who’ve taken their spouse’s name and members of the LGBTQ+ community who have changed their name — would have to jump through even more hoops. This is voter suppression, plain and simple. And that’s Republicans’ goal. House Republicans were elected to give their constituents a voice in Congress, not to ignore their struggles in order to please Donald Trump. That’s the American way.
But Trump, MAGA, and Stephen Miller have no respect for the rule of law. And they just sent a new message to ICE: make more arrests.
ICE has doubled their daily arrests, detaining roughly 10,000 people in just five days after officials ordered agents to dramatically increase arrests.
This is not the America we accept and believe in.
We deserve secure borders and safe communities. But we also deserve a government that respects due process, follows the Constitution, and never treats human beings like quotas on a spreadsheet.
I'm running for Congress because I believe we can protect our borders without abandoning our values.

Meta is **[building its first big data center in Canada](https://substack.com/redirect/08f094ea-3dd5-473a-88dc-fe27c4553c30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while planning to **[put its Iris AI chip into production](https://substack.com/redirect/750a9034-5178-468d-809b-7834e9fa4314?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in September and **[rolling out new Muse models](https://substack.com/redirect/eceba38f-f60f-44aa-ad58-64ec6ea4383b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for coding and image generation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ae9dabd-4cdf-4ad0-94b6-c8cd4d337f69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Canadian data center project:** Meta is constructing a 1 gigawatt facility in Alberta costing about $9 billion that will take two to three years to build and support over 3,000 construction workers.
* **Iris chip production starts:** The company will begin manufacturing its custom Iris AI chip in September after quick testing to **[double computing capacity to 14 gigawatts in 2027.](https://substack.com/redirect/9b37c2ed-166a-4855-a021-bda9eeb32b99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Muse spark model update:** Meta released Muse Spark 1.1 as its strongest model yet for coding and agentic work with aggressive pricing of $1.25 per million input tokens.
* **Muse image tool backlash:** The new tool uses public Instagram photos opted in by default raising alarms in Hollywood with calls for opt-in consent from CAA and SAG-AFTRA.

# [Arkansas skyrockets as Hawaii crashes to worst state for business in 2026](https://substack.com/redirect/60225620-7de2-480c-97ef-083a7708b04a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Hawaii **[finished dead last in CNBC's 2026 America's Top States for Busines](https://substack.com/redirect/d4bbeb8a-640f-4361-ae10-608404fbb5c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**s rankings due to worst infrastructure and high costs **[while Arkansas jumped 13 spots to 28th as the most improved state](https://substack.com/redirect/6da8b07d-bb77-4e2d-af4e-a4b7a01634cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** attracting workers with low costs and quality of life. The top three states were[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/2e1eba5f-6e4b-4620-b439-f1844b458027?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Ohio, North Carolina and Virginia.](https://substack.com/redirect/2e1eba5f-6e4b-4620-b439-f1844b458027?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/60225620-7de2-480c-97ef-083a7708b04a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Hawaii ranks dead last:** The Aloha State has the nation's worst infrastructure and highest business costs with its quality of life falling to sixth place due to expensive childcare.
* **Childcare costs soar Hawaii:** Childcare in Hawaii costs 18% of median income for married couples with children making it the most expensive nationally and limiting access.
* **Arkansas workforce surge:** The state climbed 23 spots to No. 13 in workforce as remote workers move for lower taxes cost of living and high quality of life.
* **Arkansas job growth rises:** Arkansas added nearly 16,000 jobs in 2025 improving its economy ranking to 20th though it still faces challenges in education and technology.

# [Big AI bets millions on 2026 election in hopes of favorable regulations](https://substack.com/redirect/60225620-7de2-480c-97ef-083a7708b04a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
AI industry **[super PACs have raised more than $200 million dollars and spent at least $44 million dollars](https://substack.com/redirect/84fa7c6e-aa75-4260-81ba-8c4ea71a36f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on 40 House and Senate candidates as of June end to influence the first national legislation regulating artificial intelligence.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/60225620-7de2-480c-97ef-083a7708b04a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Leading future PAC raises:** The group raised $125 million dollars, including from the private equity firm Andreessen Horowitz and OpenAI co-founder Greg Brockman, and spent over $24 million dollars backing candidates with most winning primaries.
* **Public first action funded:** The PAC raised $80 million dollars including $20 million dollars from Anthropic and spent $20 million dollars supporting candidates while favoring state laws unless comprehensive federal approach emerges.
* **Regulation framework sought:** Both groups push for some AI guardrails with differences on federal preemption of state laws but overlap on child protection and urgency as technology adopts quickly.
* **Candidate support success:** Vast majority of backed candidates won primaries as the industry seeks to shape AI bills in Congress modeled after crypto PAC success.

# [Micron commits staggering $250 billion dollars to US chip dominance by 2035](https://substack.com/redirect/60225620-7de2-480c-97ef-083a7708b04a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Micron Technology **[boosted its U.S. investment plan to more than $250 billion dollars](https://substack.com/redirect/fe98be8b-8167-4aa6-93ea-a6020f272438?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/fe98be8b-8167-4aa6-93ea-a6020f272438?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)through 2035 including $3 billion dollars to strengthen the semiconductor supply chain amid AI memory chip demand.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/60225620-7de2-480c-97ef-083a7708b04a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Investment plan increase:** The new commitment jumps from previous $200 billion dollars announced last June which itself was raised by $30 billion dollars from original plans.
* **Supply chain funding:** Micron will spend $500 million dollars on GlobalWafers 300 millimeter raw silicon wafer facility in Sherman Texas under the $3 billion dollars allocation.
* **Long term supply deal:** Micron and GlobalWafers entered a 10 year supply agreement for raw silicon wafer capacity to support long term manufacturing plans.
* **AI era demand:** Surging demand for memory chips in the AI era and push for domestic production drive the expanded investment with shares up more than 7%.

# [Google cofounder takes brutal 94% loss selling NYC real estate as he flees](https://substack.com/redirect/60225620-7de2-480c-97ef-083a7708b04a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Google co-founder Sergey Brin worth roughly $280 billion dollars sold his stake in a Manhattan multifamily **[fund at six cents on the dollar accepting a 94% loss](https://substack.com/redirect/60d01d1b-9e76-4610-8074-af689fd30cce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** one month after Zohran Mamdani was elected mayor on a rent freeze platform.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/60225620-7de2-480c-97ef-083a7708b04a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Brin divests distressed fund:** The third richest person via Amphitheatre LLC exited the A&E Real Estate fund owning 5,900 rent-stabilized apartments across New York boroughs.
* **Operating costs surged:** A&E expenses climbed nearly 80% over a decade while rent increases were capped at about 15% pushing the portfolio underwater.
* **Rent freeze adds pressure:** The sale occurred ahead of Mamdani rent freeze policies exacerbating existing distress from 2019 rent law overhaul and national cost pressures.
* **Institutional write downs:** UC wrote down its $115 million dollar stake in the same fund by 50% as analysts warn capital flight could shrink NYC housing supply.

* * *
* * *
# [PepsiCo warns consumers are dramatically cutting snacks and soda](https://substack.com/redirect/60225620-7de2-480c-97ef-083a7708b04a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
PepsiCo reported **[North American consumers scaled back on snacks and soda](https://substack.com/redirect/52eece0d-1ed9-4348-b1a2-a651e76fd6da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as inflation tightened budgets with category performance moderating despite price cuts and strong international results.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/60225620-7de2-480c-97ef-083a7708b04a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **North America results soften:** Snack brands saw revenue growth and pricing fall by 2% with volume flat as consumers focused on essentials amid rising inflationary pressures.
* **Price cuts ineffective:** Americans did not stock up after roughly 15% price cuts in February on Lay's Doritos Cheetos and Tostitos.
* **Healthier options perform:** Portion control multipacks, permissible health conscious products like zero sugar sodas, SunChips and Quaker Rice Cakes showed strength.
* **Outlook reiterated:** Company expects organic revenue increase between 2% and 4% and core earnings per share rise between 4% and 6% with gradual North America improvement.

Power, Prosperity, Peace
| Friends, There's a growing awareness among the working class across this state and the country as more and more Americans deeply examine why things are the way they are. And many are coming to the same conclusion.

* * *
**We do NOT have to live like this.
**
* * *
We are finally coming to see that the system is not broken. It is working exactly as designed. The ultra-rich spend millions to retain power, lawmakers and high-level party leaders play the game for their own personal gain, well-meaning, good faith Democrats work hard because they believe they are working for progress, and the ones who lose out are the everyday, working people. But there is really good news. Now that more and more people are aware of this rigged system, we are working to change it.

We CAN get money out of politics.
We CAN have real representation.
We CAN elect leaders who will deliver
OUR Power, OUR Prosperity and OUR Peace.

* * *
**But HOW will someone with low resources win?**
* * *
People ask me all the time how I'm going to get this done. The answer is that we are running a "working person's campaign," not a "millionaire's campaign." We are rewriting the campaign playbook by using [evidence-based](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/lmVmQOwLQ6dFHoK6s2WFxCbuMKRTcFr7/click?signature=5d8d1dd468c5c90f7211a1417dce7e0a3558465a&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdatascience.columbia.edu%2Fnews%2F2020%2Ffriend-to-friend-texting-increases-voter-turnout%2F) techniques that have been proven to have better outcomes than the traditional standard way of campaigning.

We have a plan. [And it's called Relational Organizing (RO).](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/lmVmQOwLQ6dFHoK6s2WFxCbuMKRTcFr7/click?signature=ae34d591e1ce9dbcf8cdef4ade1258dfe8ba80ee&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.impactive.io%2Fblog%2Fwhat-is-relational-organizing-and-why-is-it-important) The idea is simple. People who know you are 5-8x more likely to support a campaign/candidate when someone they know and trust tells them about it. (It's also a lot less expensive than buying voter lists and hiring people to canvass.)

We are implementing that RO plan via [Regional Leads](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/lmVmQOwLQ6dFHoK6s2WFxCbuMKRTcFr7/click?signature=a39832eb48e12068f8f085cf3826fc2577676c80&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.impactive.io%2Fblog%2Fyour-relational-organizing-toolkit) who coordinate the RO plan for that specific region. To win a campaign, you need money or time. If you don't have money, you make that up with time; volunteers. RO [makes it easy](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/lmVmQOwLQ6dFHoK6s2WFxCbuMKRTcFr7/click?signature=5abdbaf827e1749c61fd652e3a9e1d40aa512194&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.paigefornh.com%2Fget-organized) for any supporter to "volunteer" on their own terms.

* * *
**CALL TO ACTION**
* * *
Time is passing rapidly.
**We are less than two months from the New Hampshire Democratic Primary on 9/8/26**.
YOU can help us win this!

Can you commit to talking to 10 people you know about this campaign and our movement of working-class people? You could tell them why getting one of us to Congress matters to you. Tell them why you support the campaign. Have a real person-to-person conversation. Ask them if they might join the email list, come to an event to learn more, follow the campaign on socials, become a volunteer, or even donate.

Every one of us, each doing one small thing, adds up. There are more of us than them. Pick your thing today, and help us take our Power, Prosperity, and Peace back. [Follow us on Social Media](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/lmVmQOwLQ6dFHoK6s2WFxCbuMKRTcFr7/click?signature=43b169213dc1de9f939a54fa8b8bc3c35b020d12&url=https%3A%2F%2Flinktr.ee%2FPaigeForNH) [Relational Organizing](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/lmVmQOwLQ6dFHoK6s2WFxCbuMKRTcFr7/click?signature=5abdbaf827e1749c61fd652e3a9e1d40aa512194&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.paigefornh.com%2Fget-organized) [Volunteer](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/lmVmQOwLQ6dFHoK6s2WFxCbuMKRTcFr7/click?signature=de8a914741d68ca50d8be2890b8199c3f7ebd052&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2F22SxP9UZzC) [Donate](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/lmVmQOwLQ6dFHoK6s2WFxCbuMKRTcFr7/click?signature=6c6bbf7f1426ef5e4e82515019c4e169d76fed74&url=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fpaige-for-congress) [Join the Discord Community](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/lmVmQOwLQ6dFHoK6s2WFxCbuMKRTcFr7/click?signature=de8a914741d68ca50d8be2890b8199c3f7ebd052&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2F22SxP9UZzC) We win this by making it our mission to win it, together. Let's get to work. Our time has arrived, and this is happening!
In Solidarity, Paige [Visit our website!](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/lmVmQOwLQ6dFHoK6s2WFxCbuMKRTcFr7/click?signature=5324169cb645bb2e91e0acbb19f54a5a015afe7e&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.paigefornh.com%2F) [Share the movement](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/lmVmQOwLQ6dFHoK6s2WFxCbuMKRTcFr7/click?signature=43b169213dc1de9f939a54fa8b8bc3c35b020d12&url=https%3A%2F%2Flinktr.ee%2FPaigeForNH)

name: Julie Jaman
subject: Friend, the YMCA banned me for protecting girls – now we’ve won
body:
I fought the YMCA after they banned me for protecting girls in the locker room and won a $65,000 settlement. Help us keep fighting.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e965632/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YveVpNQ3JEV2V1Nw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDk/LbmNsdlI0U1plTQ/qP2hpZHM9bmNrTkJTRHZqSTE3NWxscw/gak_K5A/s3r4317fa1a)
| | | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._K5A/s3l07e60a3d)
---
| | | Friend _,_
---
What if this happened to you, your daughter, or your granddaughter? I’m 84 years old, and for many years I trusted the government-owned pool that the YMCA operated near me as a safe place for women and girls. **Until one day.**

I was taking a shower in the women’s locker room after a swim and when I heard a man's voice, I pulled back the curtain to look. **I couldn’t believe my eyes.** A biological man dressed in a women’s swimsuit, was standing with two young girls, helping one of them remove her swimsuit so she could use the toilet. Shocked and concerned for those little girls, I did what any protective woman would do.

I spoke up and asked him to leave the women’s space. The YMCA’s response?
**They punished me.** They called my concern **“discriminatory,”** banned me for life from all their facilities, and even called the police on **me,** not the man in the locker room.
---
[ **Donate now. Stand with Julie** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._K5A/s3l07e60a3d)
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._K5A/s3l07e60a3d)
---
**That day, the YMCA made its priorities crystal clear:** radical gender ideology over the privacy, safety, and dignity of women and children. **But I refused to be silenced.** The **Center for American Liberty** took my case and filed a federal lawsuit against the YMCA and the City of Port Townsend, Washington, demanding accountability for violating my First Amendment rights. **No American should be punished for speaking the truth.** **Today, we have a major victory.**
---
I have reached a $65,000 settlement with the City of Port Townsend and the Olympic Peninsula YMCA. The settlement includes payment of legal fees to the **Center for American Liberty**. As their CEO Mark Trammell said, “This case was never just about one woman being banned. It was about the fundamental right of every American to speak truth without fear of retaliation.” **My courage sent a powerful message:
**
**Organizations like the YMCA cannot silence concerned women without consequence**. Supporters like you made this victory possible, and your continued support will power the next battles.
---
[ **Donate now. Stand with Julie** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._K5A/s3l07e60a3d)
---
Across the country, institutions still prioritize ideology over the safety and privacy of women and girls. Women are still being punished simply for speaking up. **That’s why I’m asking you to stand with me today.** **Will you help send this message even louder?**

Will you help defend the fundamental rights of women and girls to safe, single-sex spaces?
---
**Your gift directly fuels aggressive legal action that protects women’s spaces and free speech by:**
---
* supporting critical legal brief preparation for the court
* advancing strategic****case development efforts
* funding essential legal research and analysis
* helping cover key court and filing expenses

---
| | | [_**Please consider a gift of $100, $250, $350, $500 or whatever you can give today.**_](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._K5A/s3l07e60a3d)
---
Even a small gift helps ensure more women are protected, not punished, for expecting basic safety and privacy. Thank you for standing with me and for standing up for what’s right.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._K5A/s3l07e60a3d)
---
Sincerely, Julie Jaman
---
P.S. My case proves that when we speak up and fight back, we can win. But the fight is not over. Please join me by making a gift today.
---
[ **Support the Center For American Liberty** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._K5A/s3l07e60a3d)
---

# Two years in. They're still trying to stop us.
### Here's what we built. Here's what comes next.
| | | [Drop Site News](https://substack.com/@dropsitenews)
---
| Jul 9
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dropsitenews)
---
Friends,
Drop Site News turned two years old yesterday. In the span of time it takes most news startups to find their footing, we became one of the largest independent news outlets in the world -- influencing policy, exposing war crimes, and changing what people understand about power.
That didn't happen by accident. It happened because tens of thousands of readers decided this work mattered enough to support it.
**Today, we 're asking you to join them.**
Foreign governments have banned us. The White House attacks us. Corporate legacy media scrambles to discredit us. They're all betting we won't be able to keep this up. For less than $0.25 a day you become part of the community that makes this newsroom impossible to intimidate, impossible to exhaust, and impossible to silence.
**[Upgrade to a paid subscription today, and for the next 48 hours, it's 20% off.](https://substack.com/redirect/0a3411c1-30b3-4a1d-9863-f32d450a78d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Each Drop Site investigation reaches 780,000 subscribers' inboxes, and our website reaches 24 million monthly readers. We are the #1 Newsletter in World Politics on Substack. Our Tuesday livestreams average 10,000 concurrent live viewers. Our YouTube content has crossed 14 million views. Over 750 investigations published. All of it free. All of it independent. All of it funded by readers like you.
#### **We are changing the narrative -- and those in power know it**
Two years ago, the dominant media narrative on Gaza, on Israel's influence in American politics, on the Epstein files, on what was actually driving U.S. foreign policy in the Middle East -- was largely dictated by corporate legacy outlets deferring to power. We helped change that. And the people we cover have noticed.
Drop Site has been at the center of a seismic shift in how the American public understands power. We drive the stories that legacy outlets ignore -- giving people documented evidence to understand what they were already sensing, and in many cases, to change material conditions on the ground. The genocide in Gaza. Fake ceasefire negotiations masking ongoing U.S. and Israeli aggression. AIPAC's stranglehold on Washington. The collapse of democracy in Pakistan. Authoritarian consolidation across South America. The Epstein-Israel intelligence connection. We talk to the people the White House doesn't want us talking to. They called it "America Last behavior." We call it journalism.
In two years we have helped change what the world understands about power -- and those in power have noticed. Every reader who upgrades is making a direct statement: we see what you are doing, and we are not looking away.
[You can make that statement right now. Can you support our work by becoming a paid subscriber today?](https://substack.com/redirect/0a3411c1-30b3-4a1d-9863-f32d450a78d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

#### **We need you for year 3**
Drop Site at two years is not what any of us imagined when we started. It's bigger, louder, and landing harder. The scale of what we can take on in year three But the scale of what we can take on in year three -- more global correspondents, a technology desk dedicated to Big Tech's role in human rights abuses, expanded video production, continued legal defense of our reporters -- depends entirely on how many readers are willing to step up and make this work sustainable.
Right now, a small fraction of our 780,000 readers are paid subscribers. **If even a fraction more made the switch today, it would change what we 're able to do in year 3.**
Corporate media abandoned this journalism. Those in power are doing everything they can to suppress it. [For less than $0.25 a day, you become part of the reason neither of them wins.](https://substack.com/redirect/0a3411c1-30b3-4a1d-9863-f32d450a78d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

We are two years in and we are just getting started. Thank you for being part of this.
Drop Site News
_P.S. If a paid subscription isn 't possible right now, we understand -- and our commitment to keeping all of our reporting free never wavers. But if you can, today is the day. And if a subscription isn't the right fit, [a one-time tax-deductible donation of any amount goes directly into the journalism](https://substack.com/redirect/bea87a02-e34f-417f-b4ec-dff017dd31aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). ---
Hi friend — one of the most rewarding parts of this campaign has been watching our team continue to grow. Over the past few months, people from all across Rhode Island have stepped forward to endorse our campaign for Lieutenant Governor: Community leaders, climate advocates, elected officials, neighbors. People who believe our state deserves leadership that listens first, brings people together, and actually gets things done. **I'm incredibly grateful for every single one of them. And that includes you!** **[If you haven’t had a chance yet and want to add your name to our list of community endorsers, I hope you’ll do that here>>>](https://sue4ri.com/l/tipHzCurdhPs) **
---
|
|

I was so honored to receive the endorsement of Climate Action Rhode Island and author and environmentalist Bill McKibben. Their support reflects something I've believed throughout my career: **_that Rhode Island can lead on climate while making life more affordable and building stronger communities._**

---

I'm also so grateful for my City Council colleagues who know how I approach public service because we've rolled up our sleeves and done the work together. Their confidence in this campaign means the world to me.

Just like endorsements from you, endorsements from my colleagues mean a lot — the folks who really know me best know how much I care about Rhode Island and everyone in it.

---

We’ve also have the support of many RI General Assembly members who can see clearly that this campaign is one for the people. These are folks who have been elected by their constituents across the State - and whose values and work I deeply admire. These folks are spread across Rhode Island and know our state and people well. And they know I’m the right progressive to take our shared values to every corner.

---

And as more leaders continue to join this campaign, I'm reminded that what we're building is bigger than any one endorsement. **_Because the endorsement that means the most to me is yours._** If you believe the Lieutenant Governor's office can be a force for bringing people together, tackling big challenges, and making government more accessible and responsive, [**I'd be honored to have your name alongside this growing coalition.**](https://sue4ri.com/l/pdPjPzqzPX5t)

---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2623%2E259176%2E-GEMtY) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2623%2E259176%2E-GEMtY)_

And throughout this campaign, I’m asking you to use that power. I’ll tell you what I mean by that in a moment, but before I go any further, I need you to know: [**Far-right politicians, GOP groups, you name it — they’re already hard at work, spreading lie after lie about the movement we’ve built together. I knew these attacks were coming. But now, it’s on all of us to make sure they don’t spread unchecked. Please, will you rush just $5 — split between our campaign and Blue Amp Action — ahead of our critical fundraising deadline?** ](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14212?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.07.09_Shapiro-Power_B2_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=5&akid=2623%2E259176%2E-GEMtY) | [ DONATE →](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14212?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.07.09_Shapiro-Power_B2_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=6&akid=2623%2E259176%2E-GEMtY)

In times like these, I know it can feel like small, individual actions can’t make a difference. That the politicians running the show in DC are too powerful, too isolated for any single person to make a difference. But that’s not true at all.
**And Pennsylvania would know.**
250 years ago, a group of Americans gathered in Philadelphia to declare its independence from the most powerful empire in the world. Just a small handful of people had the courage to tell the entire world that we had the power to determine America’s future. **Not a king. Not a tyrant.**
I think about that story a lot. Because I see so many parallels between then and now.
I see how small, individual actions — the decision to join a campaign, the courage to protest peacefully, the bravery to speak out against injustice — have added up and changed Pennsylvania for the better.
**That’s what this campaign is all about. Small, but significant actions all coming together into something bigger. Something unstoppable. Now, I’m asking you to join me — to take that small step and help us build a brighter future for Pennsylvania and the entire country.**

WELCOME TO THE MOVEMENT

Kathy McKinstry is running for Congress to get serious, concrete work done for the people who keep our communities running —
workers, homeowners, small business owners, and families squeezed by rising prices and corrupt politics.

Dear ,

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Kathy McKinstry, and I am honored to announce that I am running as an Independent Write-In Candidate for the United
States Congress in Ohio's 9th District.

Many of you know me through different chapters of my life, as a retired United States Marine, a disabled veteran, a wife, a
mother, an educator, a caregiver, or simply as someone who has always believed in serving others.

Service has always been at the center of my life.

After serving our nation in the Marine Corps, I experienced one of life's greatest challenges when my husband, Marcus, who also
served as a Marine, passed away while our children were still young. Like so many families across America, I had to find the
strength to keep moving forward. I raised my children as a single mother, worked in education, cared for my family, and this year
became the caregiver for my brother until his passing. Not to mention the passing of our mother two months earlier.

Those experiences shaped who I am.

They taught me resilience, responsibility, and the importance of showing up every day, even when no one is watching.

Today, I believe our communities deserve leaders who understand the everyday challenges people like you and I face because we've
lived it.

That is why I have chosen to run for Congress as an Independent candidate.

This campaign isn't about political parties. It's about people.

It's about listening, serving, and working to address the issues that matter most to our communities; housing, healthcare,
education, public safety, a healthy economy, and ensuring government remains accountable to the people it serves.

Because I am a write-in candidate, I need your help in a very special way.

When you vote for U.S. Congress in November, please remember to:

1. Find the write-in section on your ballot.

2. Write Kathy McKinstry.

3. Fill in the bubble next to my name.

That's it.

One name can make a difference.

Over the coming months, I'll be sharing more about my campaign, my priorities, opportunities to volunteer, upcoming events, and
ways you can help us reach voters across Ohio's 9th District.

If my story and my commitment resonate with you, I invite you to join this campaign. Whether you volunteer, share our message,
contribute, or simply tell your friends and family, your support will help us build a true grassroots movement.

Together, we can prove that leadership is still about service, integrity, and putting people first.

Thank you for taking the time to read this message. I would be honored to earn your trust and your vote.

With gratitude,

Kathy McKinstry
Independent Write-In Candidate
U.S. Congress – Ohio's 9th District

COST OF LIVING

RELIEF

Kathy is focused on lowering everyday costs by addressing inflation, reducing wasteful spending, and making sure families can
afford to live—not just get by.

EDUCATION & WORKFORCE REINVESTMENT

As an educator, Kathy will fight for strong schools, vocational training, and real pathways to opportunity—regardless of zip code.

REGULATE FEDERAL SPENDING

Kathy will bring disciplined oversight to Washington—cutting waste, enforcing accountability, and making sure your tax dollars are
used responsibly.

UNIVERSAL HEALTHCARE FOR EVERYONE

Kathy will work to make healthcare more affordable and accessible so families aren't forced to choose between care and financial
security.

ENFORCE LAWFUL IMMIGRATION

Kathy will restore order by enforcing existing laws, securing the border, and ensuring the system is fair, consistent, and
respected.

STRENGTHEN OUR

ECONOMY

Kathy will support small businesses, protect working families, and create real opportunities for economic stability and growth.

subject: Tuesday night James Talarico joined me and 1,289 current and prospective volunteers for an organizing call.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Powered by People, [poweredxpeople
body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240945%2E444211%2EuTseha)
I’ve never been so excited about the work we’re doing and the company we keep.
Tuesday night James Talarico joined me and 1,289 current and prospective volunteers for an organizing call that caused us to have hope and — most importantly — to take action.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260709.CuwKJA&refcode=ema20260709-240945&t=3&akid=240945%2E444211%2EuTseha)
If you missed the meeting and want to see what James and I talked about, [you can watch the replay on YouTube.](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67866?t=4&akid=240945%2E444211%2EuTseha)
An impressive 395 attendees signed up to volunteer with Powered by People for the first time -- to reach, register and turn out the young voters who will power James’ victory in November. They will join hundreds more who have been with us from the beginning doing the work all over the state of Texas.
Just as impressive, Kate and our Volunteer Experience Team called every single person who signed up Tuesday night and got 282 of them scheduled for trainings so that they will be prepared to work our events on college campuses, at clubs and coffee shops, at concerts and run clubs AND... at every single James Talarico event going forward.
And as I’m writing this 18 more have just been scheduled for trainings... Aimee, our Executive Director, and all of the organizers who work with her, are relentlessly pursuing every potential volunteer to give them a chance to join this fight. It’s what it’s going to take if we want to win.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260709.CuwKJA&refcode=ema20260709-240945&t=5&akid=240945%2E444211%2EuTseha)
They and James know that this model of meeting young voters where they are, connecting with them in person, making sure they’re registered and then personally staying in touch with them works.
In 2024, 79% of the young voters in our program voted, compared to 39% for that same demographic statewide. That was a little more than 28,000 voters back then. Imagine if we could triple or quadruple that impact!
With this team, with these volunteers, with this opportunity to partner with James Talarico, we can.
[**Please pitch in to make sure that we keep up with this surge of volunteer sign ups... pitch in to guarantee that we have what it takes to show up at every Talarico event in Texas so that in addition to cheering and rallying these young people actually vote!... pitch in to support the work that works!**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260709.CuwKJA&refcode=ema20260709-240945&t=6&akid=240945%2E444211%2EuTseha)
**[Donate $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260709.CuwKJA&refcode=ema20260709-240945&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=25&akid=240945%2E444211%2EuTseha)**
Thank you,
Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end.

# Meet Sonya Dunn
#### A Proven Leader. A Trusted Steward. A Fresh Voice for Maryland.
---

## **MY BACKGROUND AT A GLANCE**
| **• Republican Nominee for Comptroller of Maryland**
---
**• Founder & CEO of JEMH Enterprises**
•**Retired military spouse with more than 30 years supporting military families**
**• Senior Advisor supporting humanitarian and military-connected communities**
**• Former U.S. Department of State Delegate for entrepreneurship and innovation**
•**International economic development and cultural relations leader**
•**Award-winning media executive and producer**
**• MBA, multiple master's degrees, and pursuing doctoral studies in finance**
**• Mother of four and advocate for families with disabilities**
| |

---
| | | | | | | | | | |

| |

|
---

**REASON #1 - Maryland is becoming too expensive. ****Families, retirees, small businesses, and working people are feeling the pressure from higher taxes, rising fees, and a government that too often asks taxpayers for more while delivering less.****As Comptroller, I will fight for transparency, stronger oversight, and responsible management of Maryland’s money.**
---
| [READ MY REASONS AND PRIORITIES FOR MARYLAND’S FINANCIAL FUTURE](https://votesonyadunn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c4b8ca5ed46d57f82b50c73a6&id=6f04864795&e=d8ca418081)
---
| |

## **WHAT I WILL FIGHT FOR**
| $
### **Protect Taxpayer Dollars**
Taxpayer money should be managed with discipline, responsible stewardship, transparency, and respect.| | ✓
### **Increase Accountability**
The Comptroller should be an independent watchdog for taxpayers.
---|---|---
⚙
### **Modernize Government**
Technology should make government easier to understand and more responsive to the people.
| | 🔍
### **Fight Waste & Abuse**
Every dollar wasted is a dollar taken from Maryland families, seniors, and small businesses.
| | | | | | | | | | | |

body:
# THE AARON DAY SHOW
Defending Free Will in the Age of Technocracy
S3E21 • Jul 9
## S3E21: The Video That Changed James Corbett's Life. We Play It Here.
with James Corbett
[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/wKr3dW3hstt?e=938a87a89b&c2id=c1b996ddd6cdaaf4cddb384f099ac837)
In 2007, James Corbett watched an 8-minute animated video.
By the end of it, everything he thought he knew about the state, taxes, and his own life had collapsed. He walked away a voluntaryist. He never went back.
That video is called The Philosophy of Liberty. And tonight, we play the entire thing on The Aaron Day Show.
Here's the problem: the state, and now the digital control grid being built on top of it (CBDCs, digital ID, programmable money) operates on a lie. The lie is that someone else owns a claim on you. On your body. On your labor. On your children. A claim you never signed, never agreed to, and cannot opt out of.
Most people never question it. They can't. The argument has been buried under a hundred years of civics class propaganda and cable news noise.
That's what makes this video dangerous to them. It states self-ownership so plainly, so cleanly, that once you hear it, you cannot un-hear it. It has now been translated into 54 languages. It is distributed uncensorably. It spreads activist to activist, screen to screen, from Tokyo to Tegucigalpa.
James joins me to tell the story of how one video rewired his life, why he's putting his weight behind Libertas.Earth to get it into every language on earth, and why this is the counter-move to the technocratic cage being built around us.
Plus: an important update on my US Senate campaign in New Hampshire.
This is a conversion story, not a rant. Bring someone who's asking questions.

### It’s time to legalize Cannabis
By Amanda Bell
Wisconsin is losing millions of dollars a year to neighboring states. Veterans can't get the care they need. People are still in prison for something that's legal in most of the country. The bills to fix this already exist. What's missing is someone willing to push them. **Hemp** A provision buried in the 2025 shutdown deal will ban most hemp-derived THC products on November 12, 2026. Wisconsin's hemp industry is worth $700 million and supports 3,500 jobs. Farmers and small businesses got two days notice that this was part of the bill to end the government shutdown. I support reversing that ban and replacing it with sensible regulation. **HEMP Act (119th Congress):** Updates the federal definition of hemp, raises THC thresholds, and sets national labeling and testing standards. **Legalization, Taxes, and Justice** I support full federal legalization for adults, a fair excise tax starting at 5%, and tax revenue directed to community reinvestment. I support automatic expungement of non-violent convictions including distribution, release of federal cannabis prisoners, and priority licensing for impacted communities. **MORE Act (62 sponsors):** Removes cannabis from the federal controlled substances list. Includes automatic expungement, a 5% excise tax, and a community reinvestment fund. The most widely supported cannabis bill in Congress. **RESPECT Resolution (11 sponsors):** Calls for equity-focused policies and economic opportunity for communities most impacted by enforcement. **Veterans** VA doctors are prohibited from recommending cannabis even in legal states, even when a veteran asks directly. Cannabis helps veterans managing PTSD, chronic pain, and opioid and alcohol dependency. That prohibition has to end. **Veterans Equal Access Act (H.R. 1384, Rep. Brian Mast R-FL):** Lets VA doctors recommend cannabis. Passed the House and Senate Appropriations Committee in 2025. Stripped from the final bill. I'd push to pass it as permanent standalone law. We are well past time to get this legislation to the finish line. If you believe America needs to get common sense legalization, I’d be grateful for your support. You can volunteer or donate at [amandabellforcongress.org](https://p9t2.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a4fd3e9674d5b18c1181bce&u=http%3A%2F%2Famandabellforcongress.org%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D6a2321b3c828b07f745ef957%26ss_email_id%3D6a4fd3e9674d5b18c1181bce%26ss_campaign_name%3DAmanda%2BBell%2Bfor%2BCongress%2BNewsletter%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-07-09T17%253A04%253A36Z&w=68e039f025c0f2594aa3b682&c=b_6a2321b3c828b07f745ef957&l=en-US&s=yoghSNn5WOUBIrv40dolC4ySoyk%3D). Your determined candidate, Amanda Bell Candidate, Wisconsin’s 6th Congressional District

I support automatic expungement of non-violent convictions including distribution, release of federal cannabis prisoners, and priority licensing for impacted communities. MORE Act (62 sponsors): Removes cannabis from the federal controlled substances list. Includes automatic expungement, a 5% excise tax, and a community reinvestment fund. The most widely supported cannabis bill in Congress. RESPECT Resolution (11 sponsors): Calls for equity-focused policies and economic opportunity for communities most impacted by enforcement. Veterans VA doctors are prohibited from recommending cannabis even in legal states, even when a veteran asks directly. Cannabis helps veterans managing PTSD, chronic pain, and opioid and alcohol dependency. That prohibition has to end. Veterans Equal Access Act (H.R. 1384, Rep. Brian Mast R-FL): Lets VA doctors recommend cannabis. Passed the House and Senate Appropriations Committee in 2025. Stripped from the final bill. I'd push to pass it as permanent standalone law. We are well past time to get this legislation to the finish line. If you believe America needs to get common sense legalization, I’d be grateful for your support. You can volunteer or donate at . This week, we called on our own nominee for the U.S. Senate to withdraw. We hold every candidate who seeks to carry our banner to the highest standard, and we stand with women and survivors. That principle does not bend based on party affiliation.
He has now withdrawn.
The hard decision in this story was not ours. It belonged to the women who came forward, because speaking up is often costly, and we respect them for it.
Our responsibility required judgment and a willingness to act when circumstances demanded it. Circumstances demanded it. We acted.
Now we want to talk to you about what happens next, because it matters enormously.
There is no Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate in Maine.
Our party will come together, as our rules provide, to choose the Democrat who will carry our banner against Susan Collins. We will do it carefully and we will do it right. Mainers deserve nothing less.
But here is the hard truth about that gap:
Susan Collins does not pause while we confer. She has been raising money for this race for six years. Her campaign is raising more today, and it will raise more tomorrow. The corporate PACs and wealthy interests her votes protect are not waiting to see who our nominee is. They are adding to a war chest six years in the making, while our side has no candidate, no campaign, and no one answering. Whoever we choose will start this race six years behind.
Every day of this holding period is a day she banks money unanswered.
We refuse to let our next nominee start from zero.
So the Maine Democratic Party is opening the Day One Fund: money raised now, held ready, so that the moment our new nominee is chosen, they inherit a running start instead of an empty account.
Day one, they will need a statewide organizing operation already paid for.
Day one, they will need voter contact already underway in all 16 counties.
Day one, they will need to answer Collins on the air, not spend a month catching up.
That is what this fund does. Not a bailout, not a rainy-day account. A running start, waiting for whoever earns the nomination. This Senate race comes at a pivotal moment in the struggle against a government, supported by Senator Collins, that serves the interests of the wealthy and powerful at the expense of ordinary Maine people. That struggle did not end this week. If anything, our responsibility to it grew.
The party will do its job in the days ahead. We are asking you to do yours today, so that our nominee, whoever they are, walks into this fight ready. Will you chip in a split contribution between Maine Dems and Resist Reclaim Rebuild today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-mainedems]

name: Maddy Munson
subject: Act Today: Tell BLM to reject weaker grazing and land health regulations!
body:
Urge BLM to keep public lands healthy and not shut the public out of crucial land management decisions

Urge BLM to keep public lands healthy and not shut the public out of crucial land management decisions
                  

(https://support.defenders.org/s/5739426/38SyG9Xl)

(https://support.defenders.org/s/5739427/38SyG9Xl)

Speak up for Public Lands! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5739428/38SyG9Xl)

Defender,

The Bureau of Land Management manages 245 million acres of national public lands – that means the agency oversees 1 in 10 acres of the United States.

With that much land under its control, BLM’s decisions have profound consequences for ecosystems across the western states, including habitat for hundreds of threatened and endangered species.

That’s what makes their latest proposal so troubling: BLM has proposed changes to regulations that would undermine the process for identifying and correcting issues with the health of public lands and move decisions behind closed doors and out of the public eye.

Speak up before BLM cuts the public out of decisions on public lands: Tell BLM to reject weaker grazing and land health regulations! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5739429/38SyG9Xl)

If finalized, these regulations could affect the outlook for imperiled species such as sage grouse, desert tortoises, butterflies, native trout and migratory birds.

Whether you care about wildlife, clean water, recreation, hunting, fishing, or healthy ecosystems, you deserve a voice in decisions that affect America's public lands.

We have less than a week to submit comments. Don’t wait: Speak up right now and tell the BLM that healthy public lands and robust public participation in land management must be a priority!

TELL BLM: Don’t weaken public land regulations! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5739430/38SyG9Xl)

Defender, thank you for taking a moment to ensure decisions about our public lands are grounded in science and with the chance for each of us to be heard.

Sincerely,

Maddy Munson

Senior Policy and Planning Specialist (BLM)

Defenders of Wildlife

(http://www.facebook.com/DefendersofWildlife) (http://twitter.com/defenders) (https://www.instagram.com/defendersofwildlife/?hl=en) (http://www.youtube.com/defendersofwildlife) (https://www.tiktok.com/@defendersofwildlife)

Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 defenders.org (https://defenders.org)

name: James Carville
subject: They’re coming for this seat
body:
It’s
Carville.

A while ago I told you that New Hampshire was the most important race
nobody was paying enough attention to. I said this thing was in a dead
heat and the GOP knew exactly what was at stake. Now look at this:

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260709_1.vrvn4F&refcode=em20260709-1&t=1001&akid=7644%2E582294%2EpxOToM ]Semafor: New Hampshire becomes the Senate midterms' sleeper race

They’re saying New Hampshire “could be a nail-biter.” Well consider my
nails bitten.

* GOP leaders are saying New Hampshire is one of their most fertile
pickup opportunities in the entire country.
* The Senate Leadership Fund has over $17 million in TV reservations –
the most NH has seen in a decade.
* A Koch-backed super PAC has already dropped nearly $3 million on this
race.

And they’re just getting started — because New Hampshire is cheaper to
flood with attack ads than other battleground states.

They are coming for this seat. Hard.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260709_1.vrvn4F&refcode=em20260709-1&t=1002&akid=7644%2E582294%2EpxOToM ]Before you read another word, rush a contribution to Chris Pappas.
$5, whatever you can spare, because the cavalry is arriving
on the other side and we need to meet it.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260709_1.vrvn4F&amount=5&refcode=em20260709-1&t=1021&akid=7644%2E582294%2EpxOToM ]Donate $5 »

John Sununu — yeah, those Sununus — has Trump’s endorsement, a famous New
Hampshire name, and a Republican machine that’s treating this race like
the linchpin of the entire Senate map.

And here’s the thing: They’re right. If Democrats lose New Hampshire, we
need to flip five seats to take back control of the Senate instead of
four. That math just doesn’t work.

Chris Pappas is the only person who can hold this seat. He’s won New
Hampshire’s swingiest congressional district four times and knows how to
reach voters across the aisle. But he cannot — CANNOT — get drowned out on
the airwaves by GOP dark money because we aren’t waking up to the
realities of the race in the Granite State.

So here’s what I need from you TODAY:

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260709_1.vrvn4F&refcode=em20260709-1&t=1022&akid=7644%2E582294%2EpxOToM ]Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas. $5, whatever you
can spare. If we don’t rally around him right now, we’re going to wake up
in November wondering how we let New Hampshire slip away.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260709_1.vrvn4F&amount=5&refcode=em20260709-1&t=1041&akid=7644%2E582294%2EpxOToM ]Donate $5 »

I told you this race was being overlooked. Now the political press is
saying the same thing. The question is whether we do something about it
before it’s too late.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260709_1.vrvn4F&refcode=em20260709-1&t=1042&akid=7644%2E582294%2EpxOToM ]Give what you can right now. Let’s win this damn thing and flip
control of the Senate.

James Carville

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260709_1.vrvn4F&refcode=em20260709-1&t=1043&akid=7644%2E582294%2EpxOToM ]James Carville

name: Tim Walz
subject: Government should work for people, not billionaires.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Small Town PAC, [smalltownpac
body:
This is why we need to elect more leaders who know and fight for their working-class communities.
#
Peter,
DOGE is officially over. The headlines may move on, but the damage won’t.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260709-1.suYWXF&amount=5&refcode=em20260709-845&t=2&akid=845%2E34582%2EqIt9sv)
When Donald Trump let now-trillionaire Elon Musk head up the so-called Department of Government Efficiency, we heard big promises about cutting waste and helping taxpayers.
Instead, working families and rural communities paid the price while Musk treated our government like his latest side project. He took a chainsaw to federal government programs, gleefully slashing millions of dollars from public services, science and medical research, poverty relief, and more.
**More than 300,000 federal workers were fired, quit, or took a buyout** since Trump returned to the White House, with DOGE spearheading the massive layoffs. According to Mother Jones, almost 17 percent of those workers remained unemployed a year later.
And on an international level, **experts say at least 750,000 people — mostly children — died** as a direct result of DOGE’s dismantling of USAID.
**DOGE didn’t just miserably fail at its mission to cut $2 trillion in government spending — it cost lives and jobs, caused chaos, and made government services worse along the way.**
I’ve said it before: _the government should work for working people – not billionaires._
That’s why at Small Town PAC, we’re recruiting leaders who know their communities, show up year-round, and fight for the people instead of special interests.
Unlike Musk, Trump, and their allies, we don’t have billionaires on standby to write million-dollar checks. We have ordinary folks like you.
Every grassroots donation helps us organize in rural communities, recruit candidates, and win in the places too many politicians ignore — so we can prevent a disaster like DOGE from ever happening again.
**[If you’re ready to build that kind of leadership, will you chip in $5 today to join us?](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260709-1.suYWXF&amount=5&refcode=em20260709-845&t=3&akid=845%2E34582%2EqIt9sv)**

With gratitude,
Tim

Tim Walz started Small Town PAC to build a Democratic Party that invests in small towns and delivers a message that resonates with rural America.
Together, we're finding and recruiting thoughtful, hardworking people to run for office, and supporting a new generation of leaders who truly reflect and understand their communities.
**[It’s time for Democrats to expand the map and put small towns back at the forefront: pitch in now to help build our movement from the ground up.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20260709-845&t=23&refcode2=845_34582_qIt9sv&akid=845%2E34582%2EqIt9sv)**

Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out... He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning. When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers. We may be in 13% of our schools now... But in the other 87%? The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them. And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous." You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it. He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses. And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now. Fellow Patriot, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- this is it. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can send them the tools to do it. These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead. All they're waiting on... is us. Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back. And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

| Peter,
This week, we called on our own nominee for the U.S. Senate to withdraw. We hold every candidate who seeks to carry our banner to the highest standard, and we stand with women and survivors. That principle does not bend based on party affiliation.
He has now withdrawn.
The hard decision in this story was not ours. It belonged to the women who came forward, because speaking up is often costly, and we respect them for it.
Our responsibility required judgment and a willingness to act when circumstances demanded it. Circumstances demanded it. We acted.
Now we want to talk to you about what happens next, because it matters enormously.
There is no Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate in Maine.
Our party will come together, as our rules provide, to choose the Democrat who will carry our banner against Susan Collins. We will do it carefully and we will do it right. Mainers deserve nothing less.
But here is the hard truth about that gap:
Susan Collins does not pause while we confer. She has been raising money for this race for six years. Her campaign is raising more today, and it will raise more tomorrow. The corporate PACs and wealthy interests her votes protect are not waiting to see who our nominee is. They are adding to a war chest six years in the making, while our side has no candidate, no campaign, and no one answering. Whoever we choose will start this race six years behind.
Every day of this holding period is a day she banks money unanswered.
We refuse to let our next nominee start from zero.
So the Maine Democratic Party is opening the Day One Fund: money raised now, held ready, so that the moment our new nominee is chosen, they inherit a running start instead of an empty account.
Day one, they will need a statewide organizing operation already paid for.
Day one, they will need voter contact already underway in all 16 counties.
Day one, they will need to answer Collins on the air, not spend a month catching up.

Peter,
This Fourth of July, I got to celebrate America’s 250th birthday at the Hood River Parade alongside this year’s Democracy Summer interns. Watching families line the streets, neighbors come together, and a new generation of leaders get involved was a powerful reminder that democracy is never a finished product. It’s something we build, protect, and improve together.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q3?refcode=x_260709_AmericanExperiment_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q3?refcode=x_260709_AmericanExperiment_act]
The Democracy Summer interns give me hope. The Oregonians marching in the streets for their neighbors give me hope. The people who come to my town halls to share their fears and their vision of a better future give me hope.
Two hundred and fifty years into this experiment, it’s clear we are falling short. Too many people feel unsafe and economically unstable.
But the American story is one of choosing to change, to try something new, and to do better. We must decide what our next 250 years look like.
We’re building a movement that fights for climate action, immigration reform, universal healthcare, and a strong public education system, to ensure every Oregonian has a fair chance at the future we all believe is possible—and to restore power to the people.
I’m doing everything in my power to stand up for the country I know we can be. Are you with me? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q3?refcode=x_260709_AmericanExperiment_act]

body:
It's Been A Great Holiday Week On The Campaign

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/elizabethforvirginia/our-weekly-newsletter-is-here-otmgrvv01m?e=2f83c585b2)
---
|
---
|
---
| | | | | |
# _Our Weekly Newsletter Is Here!_
---
| | **What a wonderful week on the campaign trail! From celebrating the Fourth of July to connecting with voters across the district, Elizabeth had the opportunity to meet so many incredible people and build even more momentum for our campaign.****On the Fourth of July, Elizabeth was proud to celebrate our nation's birthday and reflect on our country's history and the work ahead. She joined the Hampton Park parade with the Chesterfield Democrats, handing out American flags to many new friends along the route. Later, Elizabeth and the team continued the celebrations in Colonial Williamsburg. Despite the heat, they connected with numerous voters before heading to Yorktown for the evening. ****Sunday brought a chance to cool off with a pool party and postcard-writing event, where supporters helped us reach even more voters. Afterwards, Elizabeth headed to a meet-and-greet at Hardywood, and then Richmond to speak at an Ignite America event. ****On Wednesday, Elizabeth joined fellow candidates for a fun speed-dating event. Attendees got the opportunity to hear the policy positions of each of their VA-01 candidates. Elizabeth also enjoyed speaking with the Liberal Women of Chesterfield at a happy hour, where they discussed the campaign and ways to move our community forward.****Thank you to everyone who joined us this week, whether by volunteering, attending an event, or cheering us on. Your support is what makes this campaign possible, and we're excited for everything still to come!**
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
**Upcoming Events:**
**It’s always a good time to get involved with our campaign! We’ve got lots to do this week, so come join us for a**[**Virtual Phonebank**](https://us.list-manage.com/svouoh689BM?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**or tune into our**[**Instagram Live Healthcare Town Hall**](https://us.list-manage.com/Ck8CTWAOkhy?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**on Thursday evening.****On Friday, join Elizabeth alongside the Liberal Women of Chesterfield County to hear more about her campaign. That evening, we’re excited to be hosting a **[**Headshot Fundraiser.**](https://us.list-manage.com/FUnUPduFnOj?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)** Come and get your photo taken professionally, and then chip into the campaign to take your photos home! ****Afterwards, we’ve got a busy weekend ahead of us. Join us for a**[**Canvass and Run in Williamsburg**](https://us.list-manage.com/odptUeUdfe6?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**in the morning, then stop by barbecues being hosted by the**[**Gloucester**](https://us.list-manage.com/CyCvH4u_oiC?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**and**[**New Kent**](https://us.list-manage.com/mvp7zErlSwN?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)** Democrats. Finally, tune into a **[**Veterans Round Table**](https://us.list-manage.com/rslQZNbqmvZ?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**between Elizabeth and Jason Knapp.****On Sunday, our Pool Party and Postcards event will be back by popular demand! Join us to cool off, have a swim, and write to some voters! That evening, join us at a**[**Virtual Phonebank**](https://us.list-manage.com/AyJYky0p0bc?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**, or a **[**Virtual Supporters Call**](https://us.list-manage.com/YoELoFzF8tu?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**.****Have a great week, Virginia!**
---
