[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=2579%2E251025%2Evueotc ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=2579%2E251025%2Evueotc ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter,

Graham Platner should have stepped aside sooner.

What he did is awful. Awful for the women he hurt. And awful for the
thousands who invested their hopes, their time, and their hard-earned
dollars in a candidate who had not been vetted. If you are angry about
that, you have every right to be. That anger comes from a place of love
for a set of ideals that is way bigger than one person.

But over the past few days, we have watched a different group of people go
to work. Not the volunteers and donors who are processing the feeling of
betrayal. I mean the bad faith actors: the pundits and political opponents
who never believed in any ideals to begin with.

They are seizing on this moment to suggest that any candidate who fights
for a politics that isn’t dominated by corporations and special interests
must be hiding something too. That fighting for these is somehow the same
as being "unvetted." That if you fight for working people, or you happen
to be a guy who lifts weights, you must be the next scandal waiting to
happen.

Let me tell you something.

I didn’t “come out of nowhere.” I’ve lived my life in the public eye for a
decade. I rebuilt Detroit's health department. I ran for Governor in 2018.
Since, I have written books, taught public health, and answered hard
questions on live television for years. I have been vetted by voters, by
reporters, and by opposition researchers with tens of millions of dollars
and every incentive to take our campaign and movement down.

So judge me on my work. But don’t dare judge me or our movement on someone
else’s failures.

The people pushing this comparison know exactly what they are doing. It’s
cynical and shameless. They cannot beat our message, because our message
is popular. Get money out of politics. Get money in your pocket. Pass
Medicare for All. So instead, they are trying to tie our campaign to a man
I have nothing to do with, in a race I am not running, in a state that is
not mine.

I was born and raised in Michigan, and our movement will change Michigan
politics.

So we need your help. Help us keep it focused on Michigan and our message:
money out of politics, money in your pocket, Medicare for All. And help us
defeat the bad faith actors who want to take us down. They are not
attacking us because we did something wrong. They are attacking us because
we refuse to serve what they serve: the corporations and AIPAC super PACs
trying to buy our seat.

We will never have their money. We have something better. We have each
other. And that will be enough.

Abdul

subject: Why I’m endorsing Angie Nixon (and why she needs you)

body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2338%2E791427%2ELXaqVC)
Team –
Serving in Washington isn’t easy. Every day, corporate lobbyists and billionaire-backed special interests pressure us to compromise our values and abandon the working people who sent us to DC. To take on that system, you need absolute courage. You need to be unbought, unbossed, and unafraid.
**That’s why I am proud to officially endorse Florida State Rep. Angie Nixon for the U.S. Senate.**
Angie has a proven track record of fighting for working families, demanding moral consistency from our leaders, and taking on the establishment even when it’s hard.
We hear a lot of pessimism in the national news about Florida being a lost cause, but the grassroots progressive movement in Florida is alive and well. Just this year, Florida voters flipped Trump’s own home district, where Mar-a-Lago is. The momentum is real, and Angie is next.
Right now, we are facing a massive affordability crisis. Everyday people are struggling to keep a roof over their heads, pay for groceries, and access basic healthcare, all while the political establishment caters to billionaires.
Angie is building a movement that speaks to the real needs of everyday Floridians because she actually listens and is one herself. In the Senate, she will continue her fight for a future where working people can survive and thrive, and where our communities are never left behind.
Angie is going up against massive corporate money. The establishment is doing everything it can to stop a grassroots, working-class organizer like her from taking a seat in the U.S. Senate.
**She does not have corporate PACs writing her blank checks. She relies entirely on people like you.**
If we want moral consistency and real fighters in Washington, we have to have their backs when they run.
[**Will you join me in supporting Angie’s campaign by splitting a donation of whatever amount you can afford between my campaign and Angie's today?**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-nixon.yC-YFZ&refcode=em260709-1-180&t=2&akid=2338%2E791427%2ELXaqVC)

I can’t wait to fight alongside Angie in Washington. Thank you for standing with her today.
In solidarity,
Rep. Ilhan Omar

Fellow Conservative, A constituent showed me some of the Republican text messages that have been blowing up her phone lately: **_" Have you given up on the GOP?"_** **_" Have you abandoned Trump?"_** **_" If you cared, you'd donate..."_** Those are just shameful. So, I recorded a personal message for you to say the two words that aren't said nearly enough in politics... **_THANK YOU. (please see my entire message below)_**
---
[](https://trk.email.tedcruz.)
---
Thank you for volunteering, for voting, for donating - thank you for all the blood, sweat, and tears you've poured into our Party. _God knows you 've gone the extra mile._ The idea that you've "given up" just because your voter file wasn't 100% complete and up to date is utter nonsense. Frankly, it's insulting. But I want you to know that some of us DO thank you for everything you've done. And if you have a moment, I'd sincerely appreciate it if you could verify your voter profile - because as of today, we are less than **149 days from Election Day**. _... And I **assure** you - the Democrats' voter file is near-perfect right now._ **_With less than 149 days on the clock, the single most critical step we can take to beat the Democrats is to make sure our file is 100% verified - and stays that way every week between now and November._** **So, I 'm humbly asking you to please verify your voter profile today, so we have every tool at our disposal to WIN the midterms. It was a super empowering video that gained a lot of attention and support, and it could not have been done without our fellows. There is something powerful about seeing young people choose to spend their time on a race like this. They are not waiting for politics to feel less broken before they get involved. They are getting involved because they want something better. Billionaire Rick Jackson spent $120 million to win the Republican nomination for Governor.
I'm writing to ask for $3.
No, that's not a typo.
Rick Jackson says he’s going to be "President Trump's favorite governor.”
...So we need all hands on deck right now. Will you split a $3 donation right now between my campaign and Jasmine Clark to help launch the next phase of this campaign and flip Georgia blue? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-klb]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-klb]
Look, after spending $120 million trying to buy this election, Jackson is already preparing to spend millions more to buy the Governor's Mansion.
But you might be thinking – $3 isn't very much money. How can we stand up to a billionaire with $3?
That's the point.
This campaign isn’t powered by billionaires. It's powered by thousands of people chipping in what they can because they believe Georgia deserves a governor who will fight for them.

And there's the threat from a 21st-century tool nobody saw coming when our election laws were written —**artificial intelligence.** Bad actors are already using AI to file mass, baseless challenges against voters' registrations, scraping public data to manufacture doubt about who's eligible to vote. I'm not emailing to ask you for money for some made up fundraising goal. I'm asking you to verify -- . Because the stakes have never been higher: 1. If there's one thing in this world that keeps him going, it 's fighting for patriots like YOU. But something came across my desk that really concerns me. Some Senior GOP leaders are calling it "suspicious." YOUR REPUBLICAN ADVISORY BOARD SPOT: PENDING Peter, you've been such a strong supporter of me and the President. It would be a shame to see you back out of the fight when we need you most. I 'll be the first to tell you: the 2026 election is going to MAKE or BREAK President Trump's final two years in office. He and I simply can't put all of our effort into fighting for YOU if we have a pack of Democrat impeachment wolves biting at our heels. That 's why I need you to renew your ADVISORY BOARD MEMBERSHIP in the next 10 minutes. It 's the number one thing YOU can do to show your loyalty and help secure the America First Congress our country needs. Thank you for your continued patriotism and support. Friend,

I've told you a lot about how my story has influenced my path to Congress – the son of Vietnamese refugees who risked everything for the American Dream.

Something you may not know is that I represent the largest population of Vietnamese people outside of Vietnam in the world. Westminster, Garden Grove, and Fountain Valley are Little Saigon.

**This district had never been represented by a Vietnamese American. When I ran in 2024, it was 50 years from the Fall of Saigon. I am now the first.**

Let that sink in: Our Vietnamese community had never had someone with their shared lived experience go to bat for them in Washington.

I hear from elders in our community – uncles and aunties – tell me how proud they were to vote for me. Some even crossed party lines to do so, and it helped me flip this seat by the smallest of margins.

This representation is a responsibility that I take seriously. And looking forward to our first re-election race, it's something that I refuse to take for granted.

**[There's a lot of work to do, and I can't do it without this community behind me. I've stood in solidarity with farm workers and advocated for those fleeing poverty and violence. I've worked to protect our environment, and I've been arrested dozens of times for civil disobedience. Through all these experiences, I've learned that **you have to keep up the fight. You can't give up.**

And that couldn't be more true than it is today. We need to stand up to Donald Trump _every single day_ as he works to undermine the values that make America great. [**Will you show me you're in this fight now by signing this petition? >>**](http://go.dscc.org/go/23356?ask=7&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-ND-20260709-MartinSheen-SheenStandUpToTrump-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20260709-MartinSheen-SheenStandUpToTrump-Pros-sl1&akid=24712%2E9716520%2EL7k91M)

As an activist, it's my responsibility not just to take note, but to **take action**. That's why I'm reaching out to you here and now, friend ‐‐ when we all stand for what we believe in, our voices together are louder than any one of us alone.

clean_body: | | | Friend, it's Martin Sheen. You may know me from acting ‐‐ that's how I've made my living. But activism is what I do to stay alive. I've stood in solidarity with farm workers and advocated for those fleeing poverty and violence. I've worked to protect our environment, and I've been arrested dozens of times for civil disobedience. Through all these experiences, I've learned that you have to keep up the fight. You can't give up. And that couldn't be more true than it is today. We need to stand up to Donald Trump every single day as he works to undermine the values that make America great. So much has already happened since Trump's return to office. The Trump administration dismantled the Department of Education, endangered Social Security and Medicare, targeted immigrants, slashed aid to the most vulnerable Americans and others around the world, fired thousands of hardworking federal employees, shamelessly attacked the very guardrails of our democracy, gutted the Environmental Protection Agency... I could go on and on, but the point is this: Any one of these actions would be devastating. Together, they're disastrous. As an activist, it's my responsibility not just to take note, but to take action. That's why I'm reaching out to you here and now, friend ‐‐ when we all stand for what we believe in, our voices together are louder than any one of us alone. Thank you. Our country needs us. Friend, Over the weekend, I sent a note about the bill I introduced to ban insider trading by public officials. I noticed I haven't gotten your signature yet. Ever since I took office, I’ve always made it clear why I’m here – to serve and improve the lives of mid-Michiganders. Nothing more, nothing less. Friend,
When our public officials make decisions, we should feel confident that the decisions they make will benefit the public – _not their investment portfolio._
**That’s why I introduced a bill to make sure that happens.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134952663/632696890/146200619?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZWUzOTMzYS1jNDdiLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1wX_cAO4PB6KlCAW4yCIbXMFaIAW0euenwMYebeoQI4=&emci=4858e153-b57b-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=aee3933a-c47b-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=27257697)
**Bill would ban Insider Trading by public officials**
“A new bill would ban politicians, Supreme Court Justices, and other federal officials from trading stocks and using prediction markets to wager on government and politics.”
---
This bill would block public officials from owning and trading stocks and ban them from participating in certain prediction market contracts.
Instead of working to get things done, Washington insiders are busy getting rich off their inside knowledge – all while the people they’ve promised to serve are being left behind. It isn’t right or fair. Public service is a privilege – not a paycheck.
Friend, when I was elected to Congress, I set out to fight for mid-Michiganders – not line my own pockets. It's time Washington started putting the public interest ahead of personal profit and restored the trust the American people deserve to have in their government.

Peter,

Our country is in a moment where too many politicians won't support something that's good for their own constituents if the other side happens to agree with it. _They're more interested in denying the other party a win than delivering results. I don't operate that way._

In Congress, I'll support policies because they're what's best for Iowans, not because talking heads in Washington tell me to. There are plenty of issues that shouldn't be red or blue. They should just be common sense.

Which brings me to renewable energy, and I think we can all agree:

**Iowa is already a renewable energy powerhouse.**

We're the second-largest producer of wind energy in the country, and nearly 60% of our electricity comes from wind power. Thousands of Iowans work in the industry; it helps keep electric bills low, and it's a major driver of economic growth across our state. We should be building on that success, creating additional good-paying jobs and attracting even more investment to Iowa!

_This shouldn't be controversial._ But Mariannette Miller-Meeks chose party politics over Iowa when she voted for the "Big Ugly Bill." Her vote eliminated billions of dollars in wind energy incentives and cut clean energy tax credits that support solar projects and battery storage. At a time when other states are competing for these jobs and investments, she pulled the rug out from under one of Iowa's greatest economic strengths.
**[I believe we can protect our environment and strengthen Iowa's economy at the same time. That's the kind of common-sense leadership I'll bring to Congress. subject: When you take corporate money, your priorities shift
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Truth to Power PAC
body:
The only way we’ll make life more affordable is by electing leaders who reject corporate PAC money and put the people first.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41505%2E3422442%2EXip6nF)
Peter,
Did you see this recent headline?
[](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260709_1_ak.QSOtVE&refcode=em20260709-41505&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41505%2E3422442%2EXip6nF)
After taking office again, Donald Trump cashed in. **While working families everywhere struggle to make ends meet, his personal fortune has increased by _billions_.**
It's a pattern we know all too well: **Politicians like Trump rake in huge corporate checks, do their bidding when in power, then profit while everyday Americans pay the price.**
When a politician takes corporate money, their priorities shift. They stop fighting for you, and start fighting for the same corporations that got our country into this mess.
The only way we’ll bring down prices and make life more affordable is by electing leaders who reject corporate money and put the people first.
**I have never taken a dime of corporate PAC money.** All my work has been powered by everyday people chipping in what they can, when they can. My organization, Truth to Power, is following that exact same rule.
Because we reject corporate PAC money, we’re counting on grassroots supporters like you, Peter, to step up and help us reach our fundraising goals.

Katie Porter

| | Hey friends,
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s8m7ed78d96), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s4p94934b3c) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s1l76b0512f). Also, check out yesterday's [deep-dive video](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s1m5a768157) on Children's Hospital Colorado insurance data surrounding gender treatments.
Here's a summary of today's top stories:
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** The GOP governor's primary is [nearly deadlocked](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/sfmbeee4b75), Marx leading Kirkmeyer by ~2,000 votes at 98% counted. Kiros' upset of DeGette has spurred [Blau's independent CD-1 bid](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/sdnf069262d). An NRA-backed lawsuit [challenges Denver's assault weapons ban/magazine limit](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s0l53c23278). SCOTUS will hear [Nebraska's Perkins Canal water suit](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/scl2142ece0); AG Weiser vows to fight it. PILF is [suing DPS over alleged racial gerrymandering](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/sag3308fde4) in its 2024 redistricting map.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** [U.S. forces struck Iran Wednesday](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/seq42542383) after Tehran hit tankers in the Strait of Hormuz; CENTCOM calls it a ceasefire breach, response 4-5x larger than prior strikes, no casualties. Separately, 1,000+ rallied in D.C. for "Next250," unveiling an [alternative "Declaration of Interdependence"](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s7u1590d21e) and calling to dismantle U.S. institutions.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Coleman calls for [limiting top offices to natural-born citizens](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/sar6acc7521). Gaines urges [input on CHFA's housing tax credit plan](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s2m7dbada1b) and flags a Boulder case where two Honduran nationals were bonded out before ICE intervened. O'Donnell's voter-roll series shows [ballot custody weakening post-USPS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s2t1d5a7572), with shelters distributing hundreds unsupervised and drop boxes making the 10-ballot limit unenforceable.
This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, July 9, 2026.
– Team RMV

---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Federal lawsuit says Denver school board used race to draw voting districts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/sai6d459c18)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s9ke3ed673c)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/sbjcbdfe7ce)
A conservative election-law firm filed a federal lawsuit against the Denver Public Schools Board of Education on July 2, arguing the board deliberately drew its school district voting map along racial lines. The board’s own words, the suit says, prove it.
The suit was filed in U.S. District Court in Colorado by the Public Interest Legal Foundation, a Virginia-based nonprofit, on behalf of Denver residents Susan Moore and Valdamar Archuleta. It targets Map C, the redistricting plan DPS adopted in April 2024 following the 2020 census.
The complaint does not just allege that race played a role. It argues race was the point.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s0qaee56072)**
|
---
**[Colorado’s dirty voter roll: Following the ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s0i3e6d9e4f)** BY MIKE O'DONNELL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s4v39b079e5)
_From unsupervised shelters distributing hundreds of ballots to unguarded drop boxes where 574 ballots sat uncounted for three months, Colorado's vote-by-mail system hands ballots to unsupervised intermediaries at nearly every step._
* Colorado law requires bipartisan oversight for ballots at licensed group homes and county jails — but applies zero equivalent oversight to shelters, food banks, dorms, and commercial mail stores; Denver's St. Francis Center alone received 365 ballots to distribute for the current primary with no chain of custody requirements.
* Colorado's ten-ballot harvesting limit is effectively unenforceable with unguarded drop boxes expanding statewide — the same infrastructure where 574 ballots sat unopened and uncounted for three months in Mesa County in 2020, and where ballot arson was reported in Los Angeles County as recently as May 2026.
* Out-of-state students registered in Colorado routinely abandon their registrations after graduating, leaving active ballots mailed to campus addresses where discarded ballots represent a fraud vulnerability the Secretary of State has shown no interest in closing.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/sfjcd0c5a46)**

**BY CHRISTINE COLEMAN | COMMENTARY | JULY 8** When God brought the children of Israel into the Promised Land, He established clear laws and commandments for their governance. Among them was the explicit requirement that rulers must be chosen from among their own people — no foreigner born outside the nation was permitted to rule over God’s covenant people.
**[Children’s Hospital Colorado insurance data tells one story—its testimony another.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s7n325d8533)**

Hundreds of children were provided puberty blockers or cross-sex hormones by Children’s Hospital Colorado’s TRUE Center for Gender Diversity annually in 2024 and 2025 — in numbers that may be more than 35 times higher than those previously reported in 2024 by medical watchdog group Do No Harm.

**[Pickens Technical College signed a disability agreement. Then dismissed the student.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wSg/s5h628f6727)**
**BY SHAINA COLE | LOCAL | JULY 7** _Some mornings, she didn’t know how she got to where she was. A Colorado Springs woman who asked to remain anonymous — referred to here as CSW — had been an EMT for more than a decade, a career she began while volunteering with a fire department. She shared dozens of emails documenting her case with RMV._ __

subject: Trump Pardoned J6ers… Now what?
body:
It’s been over a year since President Trump pardoned us J6 prisoners. But even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers...

Patriot,

It’s been over a year since President Trump pardoned us J6 prisoners.

But even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers...

**Some are homeless to this day. Some can’t get a job because of the time they’ve spent in jail. Many are struggling to return to some semblance of a normal life.**

They have been separated from their families for years. They have had their rights stripped from them. They can’t vote. They can’t own a firearm.

Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life — law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions.

_And they were hunted down in a political persecution that denied them their constitutional rights._

So what comes next for J6ers?

There are nearly 1,600 Americans who need to rebuild their lives. That’s exactly what Stand in the Gap Foundation is helping them do.

[Patriot, as a personal favor to me, can you please send an urgent donation of $10 or more? I am hoping to get 100 supporters to help us in our mission to rebuild the lives of J6ers who need us now more than ever.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e7170307/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9zdGFuZC1pbi10aGUtZ2FwL3NiLWFjdGlvbi8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDk/LbmNsZEFCdXY0eQ/qP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1zaXRnMjYwNjA4JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09cmV2c2hhcmUmdXRtX3Rlcm09MjMyNTRfd3IxJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9c2ImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9dGV4dF9saW5rMQ/gak_1HQ/s2r7b04fc15)
[Donate](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._1HQ/sfmb5ac876a)
Stand in the Gap Foundation originally started to help reunite families with a loved one incarcerated due to J6. Now, our focus is on helping those J6ers navigate the challenging process of re-entry into society after being incarcerated.

We are committed to providing comprehensive, practical support to ensure that each individual can rebuild their life with dignity, hope, and purpose.

Our mission is deeply rooted in the conviction that legal forgiveness is only the beginning. We want to give J6ers the support to fully reintegrate into their communities with the strength to start anew.

[Please consider donating $10, $35, $50, $100, or any amount you can generously afford today. >>](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e7170307/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9zdGFuZC1pbi10aGUtZ2FwL3NiLWFjdGlvbi8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDk/LbmNsZEFCdXY0eQ/qP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1zaXRnMjYwNjA4JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09cmV2c2hhcmUmdXRtX3Rlcm09MjMyNTRfd3IxJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9c2ImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9dGV4dF9saW5rMg/gak_1HQ/s3he78e0f3b)

[Donate Any Amount](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e7170307/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9zdGFuZC1pbi10aGUtZ2FwL3NiLWFjdGlvbi8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDk/LbmNsZEFCdXY0eQ/qP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1zaXRnMjYwNjA4JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09cmV2c2hhcmUmdXRtX3Rlcm09MjMyNTRfd3IxJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9c2ImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9YW55X2J1dHRvbjE/gak_1HQ/s3ib08349f7)
Surprisingly, there are very few resources for people who are released from prison, particularly if they are conservative or America First activists. While some J6ers come from families with means, most do not.

We were founded to “stand in the gap” for those in prison and those navigating life after incarceration. We want them to know that they are not forgotten.

This begins by providing housing and vehicles, counseling, and confidential peer support; the tools needed for healing and reintegration.

**The J6ers are our neighbors.** They are sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, mothers and fathers.

It is up to us to ensure that they have the resources needed to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity.

[If you are willing to stand with me to help these patriots rebuild their lives, please join me by donating whatever you can generously afford to help Stand In The Gap Foundation today.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e7170307/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9zdGFuZC1pbi10aGUtZ2FwL3NiLWFjdGlvbi8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDk/LbmNsZEFCdXY0eQ/qP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1zaXRnMjYwNjA4JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09cmV2c2hhcmUmdXRtX3Rlcm09MjMyNTRfd3IxJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9c2ImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9dGV4dF9saW5rMw/gak_1HQ/s2j0697f7c4)

But even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers... | | | | | | | | | | | Patriot, It’s been over a year since President Trump pardoned us J6 prisoners. But even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers... Some are homeless to this day. Some can’t get a job because of the time they’ve spent in jail. Many are struggling to return to some semblance of a normal life. They have been separated from their families for years. They have had their rights stripped from them. They can’t vote. They can’t own a firearm. Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life — law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions. And they were hunted down in a political persecution that denied them their constitutional rights. So what comes next for J6ers? There are nearly 1,600 Americans who need to rebuild their lives. That’s exactly what Stand in the Gap Foundation is helping them do. Stand in the Gap Foundation originally started to help reunite families with a loved one incarcerated due to J6. Now, our focus is on helping those J6ers navigate the challenging process of re-entry into society after being incarcerated. We are committed to providing comprehensive, practical support to ensure that each individual can rebuild their life with dignity, hope, and purpose. Our mission is deeply rooted in the conviction that legal forgiveness is only the beginning. We want to give J6ers the support to fully reintegrate into their communities with the strength to start anew. Surprisingly, there are very few resources for people who are released from prison, particularly if they are conservative or America First activists. While some J6ers come from families with means, most do not. We were founded to “stand in the gap” for those in prison and those navigating life after incarceration. We want them to know that they are not forgotten. This begins by providing housing and vehicles, counseling, and confidential peer support; the tools needed for healing and reintegration. The J6ers are our neighbors. They are sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, mothers and fathers. It is up to us to ensure that they have the resources needed to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity. Sincerely, Shane Jenkins Founder and Executive Director of Stand in the Gap Stand In The Gap is registered as a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. All contributions are tax-deductible to the extent permitted by law. | | | | | | Hey everyone, It’s Adam again. Actually me, no staff or AI.
Checking in and sharing a podcast I was recently on. I talked to friend and fellow veteran Carlos Gomez for about 2 hours last week. It was one of my favorite interviews yet on the campaign trail, and I think if you give a listen, you’ll enjoy the chat.
August 4th is just a month away and we’re making our final media push. I’m hoping to use this video (and some other exciting stuff that’ll drop in the next couple weeks) in an advertising/media blitz. So, give a listen, let me know what you think if you have ideas, and if you can: [Donate to the campaign](https://us.list-manage.com/fpWwiZpvDqS?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). I need to raise about $30,000 to run a proper digital game ahead of election day.
I ran the numbers and we need around $200 average donation to pull this off. So, everyone who reads this email, if you can throw $200 at us, that’s all the ammunition we need to dominate the last few weeks of this election. If you can’t afford it, anything helps. If you can’t afford anything, no worries. I also can’t afford anything these days! So we’re together in that at least.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/TuIgX8GPBNv?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
| | | | | | | | | | | | Once again, I appreciate all of you deeply. I know these fundraising emails are annoying, and I wish I didn’t have to keep sending them. But we’re almost there! And things are looking better than we could have ever expected. We are _this close_ to pulling off a major upset, and that is all thanks to your support. I owe a blood debt to each and every person who helped get us this far, and I won’t forget that.
\- Adam

There’s no way to sugarcoat this: A federal judge just refused to block Donald Trump’s executive order to create a federal voter list and limit mail voting.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
FIGHT BACK [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
That means the fight to protect free, fair, and accessible elections just suffered a blow — and the stakes could not be higher.
Trump and his allies are still trying to sow distrust in our elections, restrict access to the ballot box, and give the federal government unprecedented control over how Americans vote. They’re targeting vote-by-mail even after repeated audits and investigations confirmed there was no widespread fraud in the 2020 election.
And make no mistake: this is exactly why we need everyone on board, fighting back harder than ever to save our democracy and the rule of law.
In Oregon, we know vote-by-mail works. We’ve spent decades building a system that is secure, accessible, and trusted by voters across the political spectrum. But national attacks on voting rights don’t stop at state borders.
As Secretary of State, I’ll do everything in my power to protect Oregon voters, defend election workers from political intimidation, and ensure our elections remain free from partisan interference.
But I can’t do this alone. We to prove that Oregonians are ready to stand together against these attacks on democracy. Will you chip in before midnight to help me continue this fight? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
The courts may not have stopped this latest attack yet — but voting rights advocates are continuing the legal battle, and we must continue organizing, mobilizing, and preparing for what comes next.
This campaign is about protecting democracy itself. And it will take all of us working together to win.
Thank you,
Tobias Read

# **$28 Billion Nasdaq feast comes with a Korean flavor**
The Koreans just served up a $28-29 billion Nasdaq feast under ticker SKHY. Seven times oversubscribed, HBM leader with 56% market share, stock already up 636% in the last year. AI memory famine is not easing. This is the pickaxe sale in the real gold rush and US investors finally get direct access while shortages keep prices fat.
• **Winners?** Smart US retail and institutions loading SKHY for pure AI leverage; Hynix itself scores capital to build that Indiana fabrication facility and they keep feeding Nvidia.
• **Losers?** Shorts who doubted the supercycle; any gadget maker still paying through the nose for HBM.
• **Next?** SKHY opens with a double-digit pop, lifts the whole memory crew, and capex ramps hard while shortages stretch into 2027.
Memory kings are printing and SK Hynix just joined the club. Shortages persist, prices stay elevated. Load the boat or watch the train leave the station. This is how you get paid in the AI buildout.

# **Grok 4.5 and 2t models signal xAI is accelerating at warp speed**
The xAI engine just dropped the hammer: Grok 4.5 launches hitting 1.5T parameters with 1M token context coming imminently, 2T model training this month, monthly new foundation models through 2026, and real-world engineering loops with Tesla and SpaceX. This is not hype this is execution at Mach 10.

# **Oil falls as Iran-US tensions ease faster than the market expected**
Oil dipped 2.6-2.7% to $71.57 WTI and $75.78 Brent after the initial spike on US strikes. Mediators from Qatar and Pakistan are already pushing talks. Hormuz closure is not priced in and the market is calling the bluff on full escalation.
• **Winners?** Traders who bought the dip and anyone long energy names that got oversold on headlines.
• **Losers?** Bulls who piled in expecting $90+ on pure geopolitics fear; weak hands who panic-sold the opening spike.
• **Next?** More skirmishes but no real supply shock, oil stays range-bound until the next headline or actual deal.

# **Goldman Sachs asset management locks in $70 billion dollars of stable retirement fees**
Goldman just bagged $70 billion in retirement assets from Verizon and Lockheed Martin. Stable, recurring fee income on complex 401k and pension portfolios. No more relying on volatile investment banking this is the fee machine on steroids.
• **Winners?** Goldman's asset management division locking in predictable cash flow for years; the clients outsourcing the headache.
• **Losers?** Smaller asset managers who can't compete on scale or the old-school bankers still chasing deal fees.
• **Next?** More corporations follow the outsourcing trend and Goldman's AUM keeps compounding at low risk.
This is Wall Street at its best turning steady retirement money into a cash cow. No drama, just fat margins. Smart money loves recurring revenue. The rest chase the shiny IPOs and get burned. Goldman just reminded everyone who really prints.

# **Ohio claims the number one spot in America 's top states for business rankings**

Peter,
MAGA claims that ineligible immigrants and dead people vote all the time, always to help Democrats of course.
But it turns out that there is at least one immigrant committing election fraud in America: Elon Musk.
In 2025, Musk infamously tried to bribe voters in Wisconsin with a $1 million reward to help Republicans try to win the hotly-contested State Supreme Court race there, despite the Wisconsin AG suing to stop the giveaways as an illegal bid to buy votes.
In 2024, Musk had done the same thing, except with added layers of deception: the "petition" from which prize winners were selected--titled "Petition in Favor of Free Speech and the Right to Bear Arms"--was only available to registered voters of Arizona, Georgia, Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, Nevada, or North Carolina.
And now, Musk's America PAC has been linked to a shady voter registration mass mailer rife with inaccurate info that was just sent out to residents across North Carolina from a shadowy group called "Ready to Register":
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001f7Skg1tvAt5rBAtaXzJMWMF4gtWVCmWmf5Pi-HcCQUnZ54XHBlniKfYLKCdegVxsM5oE129dTKoMejwQM01qZvQF0aYkKWJKPdd4VgyQpRJpVmbTZAogv2fOSxoxKoFkkaFj44bzK4CpOJ3SxQbyqShZaJ4HOelpE-xxp95568PS77zBJH1xjS7-m9LptoJuMRLpvOog2QcxV-aoeEXQGyDX4Wm6yxRxbVHWcwRZLBc=&c=bKHDyRw65TgYD4SqxwlqH5ldZ1e1OAe1Q5_6vyAFAFIi-Ei_2rIaOQ==&ch=NShL0Qu5NbjuAQhxCv2GGVn0w5PQYMhs1eNLgm-5Tba0TaosRvwnmw==)
---
Incompetence is the only reason we know about the link to Musk and America PAC: according to the Washington Post, the website for Ready to Register has source code that links to America PAC, and a disclaimer for signups consenting to texts, calls, and emails from America PAC.
One theory about the mailers is that Musk and the MAGA operatives behind Ready to Register are laying the groundwork to prompt select voters to submit incorrect information about themselves to election authorities--which could then be used as a basis to claim mass voter fraud.
Ready to Register's Facebook ads account has been running ads since late June targeting users in three swing states with enormous stakes for control of both the House and Senate: North Carolina, Georgia and Ohio.
We have to work right now, not three months from now, to stop the Trump Administration AND evil mustache-twirling billionaires like Elon Musk from trying to rig the November midterm election.
Outreach to voters will be key. Defend Our Courts is preparing an aggressive voter protection strategy to inform voters of their rights and report problems at the polls. We are also investing in a firewall of state courts and key judicial posts to safeguard our elections.
[Musk has already spent over $250 million to elect Donald Trump and keep Republicans in power. He has only become richer since then. | For years, "the political class" has treated Democrats who call for corporate influence in our elections as a social media trend they could wait out.
But then, working people started winning and beating their candidates on this exact platform.
In Denver, in New York, and across the country, voters are choosing candidates who are willing to name the thing establishment Democrats have tiptoed around: our economy is rigged by billionaires, corporate PACs, weapons manufacturers, Big Pharma, landlords, and lobbyists who have been allowed to treat our government like their private investment portfolio.
That is why these wins are causing a political earthquake.
They're proof that people are hungry for leadership that does not apologize for wanting Medicare for All, housing people can afford, a real arms embargo against Israel, and a government that fights for working families with the same urgency it fights for Wall Street.
But the part the headlines will not capture is what it took to get here.
Thousands of conversations, volunteers giving up nights and weekends, small-dollar donors, and a whole lot of people refusing to let dark money decide what was possible.
But now we have to refuel.
We spent down our resources to win this race because that is what this moment required, but if this movement is going to keep growing, if we are going to help elect more true progressives and make sure Denver's victory becomes part of something much bigger, we need the resources to keep going.
[So can I count on you to chip in and help us keep building this movement?](https://cefuo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010OO0uttuVVVqCrWzaWIH2xhO5-VR_h2fT-__22OrSTNIS_kRduwq6L_LuY14ETqp2YOMOXDHp5C2sjEAmeXtPH9ANp6NjSMbJGsWJsnhxns88u9rBDsh-fZKbzmEvlPOVCUi3W0r1EjdvvY-fXMV9tCE8KyNaUC4gP2F8omLhLHI9HksT5S6KyZKDxC4hjFjCxfMkqVujH9NiBDSOL9adel483ydxpFK76QDSLiaVd8NaDDljGZ5KA==&c=576otN1X8xxirA7XXnluLU8zQ8f9DVB9tozHFqDfyJfM7bBnuRdKJQ==&ch=zn5648FlEmvAFGUYc0L-Lq8uguLFhCv7VSKJLussKT9i9NszcWoPTQ==)

We're done waiting, and now we're going to keep going.

**I’m honored to be reaching out today as the official Democratic nominee for Governor of Colorado.**
Supporters like you have always been the power behind this grassroots campaign. And even as we celebrate the end of this primary, we are setting our sights on this movement’s next challenge: the general election on Tuesday, November 3.
**[We’ve set a goal of earning 2,000 individual contributions to keep our momentum going. Will you be one of the first to split a contribution between our General Election Fund and Aaron Ford?>>> ](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260709_1_ak.9ErHo2&amount=5&refcode=em20260709-445&t=3&akid=450%2E127862%2EJKbxs6)**

As Colorado’s next governor, I’m ready to get corporate money out of our elections and ensure our political system stays focused on delivering for all of us, not just the wealthy few.

name: David Crowley
subject: Yesterday, I made the decision to end my campaign.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CROWLEY FOR WISCONSINP
body:
Can you make sure it counts?
---
|
---
| [ ](https://act.davidcrowley.org/l/9mM7PFPU5Vg3)
---
Peter,

Yesterday, I made the decision to end my campaign for Governor of Wisconsin. Before anything else, I want to say thank you. Thank you to everyone who donated, hosted an event, knocked on doors, made phone calls, sent texts, put up a yard sign, shared our message online, and talked to friends and neighbors about our campaign. Thank you to everyone who gave what they could — whether it was your time, your treasure, your talent, or your faith in what we were building together. This campaign was never about one person. It was about a shared belief that Wisconsin deserves leadership that shows up, tells the truth, and gets things done for working families. Over the course of this campaign, I traveled to every corner of our state — from dairy farms to church basements to coffee shops and community centers. Everywhere I went, I heard the same concerns from Wisconsin families: Rent is up. Energy bills are up. Childcare is nearly impossible to find. Those challenges are real, and the ideas we ran on to address them remain just as important today as they were when we launched this campaign. As Democrats look toward November, I believe this election is too important for us to be divided. Wisconsin families deserve a governor who can win, govern, and deliver results from day one. **That is why I am proud to endorse Lt. Governor Sara Rodriguez for Governor of Wisconsin.** I have said that the next governor’s job description is simple:
1. Make this state affordable
2. Make sure care shows up for families _before_ a crisis
3. Build real opportunity from the classroom to a good-paying job

That's what my campaign was about, and Lt Governor Sara Rodriguez fits that job description. Sara has spent her career serving others — first as a nurse, then as a legislator, and now as lieutenant governor. She has spent her career showing up for people on their hardest days, and she understands that if you’re not at the table, you’re on the menu. People don’t care what you know until they know how much you care – and Sara cares deeply. She is also the strongest candidate to defeat Tom Tiffany and stop the extreme agenda he would bring to the governor's office. Wisconsin cannot afford to move backward on reproductive freedom, public education, healthcare, or economic opportunity.
Most importantly, I believe Sara will be a governor who listens, brings people together, and delivers for working-class families in every corner of our state. To everyone who believed in our campaign:**the work does not end here.** The values we fought for — affordability, opportunity, dignity for working families, and a government that delivers results — do not leave this race simply because I did. The best way to carry those ideas forward is to unite behind Sara Rodriguez and elect her as Wisconsin's next governor. Thank you for believing in this campaign. Thank you for believing in me. And thank you for everything you did to help us build something bigger than ourselves. With gratitude, David Crowley
---
|
---

Milwaukee, WI 53203

---

Hey folks,
[Jack Cocchiarella](https://open.substack.com/users/112946688-jack-cocchiarella?utm_source=mentions) and I covered a lot in this one--and honestly, it's one of those conversations where every topic points back to the same bigger problem: accountability. We dug into the mystery surrounding Mitch McConnell, the questions nobody in the media seems willing to ask about Trump's health, and why our political system keeps rewarding people who refuse to let go of power. We also managed to laugh a little along the way, because if you don't find moments of joy in all this, they'll wear you down.
**Here are some moments you don 't want to miss:**
* [**00:02:49**] We break down the unanswered questions surrounding Mitch McConnell's disappearance, why Republicans are protecting the situation, and what it could mean for control of the Senate.
* [**00:08:24**] The conversation turns to term limits, transparency, and why elected office is a privilege--not something anyone is entitled to keep forever.
* [**00:16:29**] We dig into Trump's health, the lack of public accountability, and why voters deserve honest answers from every president, regardless of party.
* [**00:19:44**] We talk about media desensitization, the stories that disappear too quickly, and why following through matters just as much as breaking the news.
* [**00:22:17**] We close with the bigger lesson: everyone who chooses loyalty to Donald Trump eventually gets burned--and why real accountability has to come for the people who enabled all of it.

This episode is about the culture of secrecy, entitlement, and impunity that keeps failing the American people. If you care about honest conversations, real accountability, and making sense of where this country is headed, this is a must-watch. If you value conversations like this, help me keep building them.

Peter, This week, our community was shaken by the murder of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo by ICE during their operation in Houston. Federal officials have offered an account that mirrors the provably false claims they have made in their other fatal shootings. Houston leaders, including our past endorsee, Congressman Christian Menefee, are demanding a full, independent investigation, the release of all available evidence, and accountability for what happened. We join them in that demand. Moments like this also remind us why local elections matter. Way to Lead was proud to endorse Christian Menefee because he isn't afraid to stand up to federal overreach or to fight for the dignity of every person who calls Texas home. He has been clear: **every person in our community deserves safety, transparency, and dignity — not fear of being murdered by their own government.** Christian’s courage makes a difference, and that is exactly why our PAC has backed other bold, reform-minded leaders across the South who are committed to standing up for their constituents against ICE. Our endorsed DAs, like Austin District Attorney Jose Garza and Norfolk District Attorney Ramin Fatehi, helped launch F.A.F.O. (Fight Against Federal Overreach) to prosecute abusive federal immigration enforcement and get ICE out of our neighborhoods. Our candidates believe that public safety comes from trust and opportunity, not from unaccountable, militarized thugs in our streets. But the forces defending the status quo are well-funded, organized, and determined to silence those who challenge them. Federal officials have offered an account that mirrors the provably false claims they have made in their other fatal shootings. Houston leaders, including our past endorsee, Congressman Christian Menefee, are demanding a full, independent investigation, the release of all available evidence, and accountability for what happened. We join them in that demand. Moments like this also remind us why local elections matter. Way to Lead was proud to endorse Christian Menefee because he isn't afraid to stand up to federal overreach or to fight for the dignity of every person who calls Texas home. He has been clear: every person in our community deserves safety, transparency, and dignity — not fear of being murdered by their own government. Christian’s courage makes a difference, and that is exactly why our PAC has backed other bold, reform-minded leaders across the South who are committed to standing up for their constituents against ICE. The fight just got harder, but I’m not backing down.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260709-6447-footer&t=1&akid=6447%2E420207%2El9tWJv)
Peter,
Watching the Supreme Court move in this direction is **genuinely devastating.**
Recently, the Court gave Trump the green light to end Temporary Protected Status for people from countries facing ongoing crises and to shut the door on asylum seekers fleeing persecution.
Let’s be clear: this isn’t about “the worst of the worst.” Trump and Stephen Miller are targeting highly vetted people who could face violence, instability, or _even death_ if they’re forced to return home.
**These rulings will tear families apart, hurt our communities, and embolden an immigration agenda rooted in cruelty.**
I’m going to keep fighting for a pathway to citizenship, restored asylum protections, and an immigration system that recognizes our shared humanity.
[**So please, if you’re with me, can you chip in $3 to help me keep up the fight against Trump?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260709.TX_Ivs&refcode=em20260709-6447&amount=3&t=2&akid=6447%2E420207%2El9tWJv)

body:

I need to tell you something I don't talk about enough.
Outside of my office, a group of extremists gathered and screamed what translates to "Death to Krishnamoorthi" at the top of their lungs.
A crowd of people, in America, calling for my death.
I'm an immigrant. The son of people who came to this country with nothing because they believed it was a place where you could live freely, speak freely, and serve your community without fearing for your life. A place where disagreement didn't end in threats of violence.
Sadly, this is nothing new. I have faced this before.
A sitting Republican elected official also publicly tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media to report me as a "foreign occupier" with an "unpronounceable name" and called for the mass deportation of Indians. I have been mocked, threatened, and told in a hundred different ways that someone like me doesn't belong in American public life.
And every single time, I have made the same choice.
Keep going.
Because the moment I stop — the moment I let the hatred win — is the moment I break faith with every family that came to this country believing it was worth fighting for. Including my own.
This is the America we are living in right now. Extremists feel emboldened to threaten, intimidate, and silence the people who are trying to do the work. Hatred has been given permission to operate in the open. The machinery of government is being used to make certain communities feel like they don't belong.
Equal Opportunity Now exists because we need leaders who have faced this kind of hatred and didn't flinch. Who know what it costs to keep going and choose to keep going anyway. Who will stand up — not just for themselves, but for every family that is being targeted, threatened, and told they don't belong.
Those leaders are out there. And they need our support right now.
Will you chip in $10, $20, or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us elect leaders who won't be intimidated — no matter what they face? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]

They can scream all they want.
We are not slowing down.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi

Friend, We just kicked off the last full quarter before Election Day, and I want to be honest with you about why I'm doing this. I'm running for Congress because I've lived the struggles so many families in TX-21 face every day. I grew up paycheck to paycheck; I relied on Pell grants and student loans to get an education, and I watched my mom work multiple jobs just to get by. I became a scientist because I believe in facts and evidence. I became a public servant because I believe government can be a force for good. And I'm running for Congress because working families in this district deserve a representative who fights for them, not for corporate donors and dark money. This quarter is our biggest chance to prove that a people-powered campaign can beat a Washington insider bankrolled by special interests. name: Sharice Davids
subject: I don’t look like your typical member of Congress
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHARICE FOR CONGRESS
body:
That’s something I’m proud of

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134961581/632725031/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjM1MGYxMS1kZTdiLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iXRszT2qVG-x4JI1E1QPMBi0qNHqOdjAUN7tFcKMOVA=) If you compare me to some of the other folks you see in Congress, you’ll notice something: **I stand out.** I’m the only LGBTQ+ Native American woman ever elected to Congress. I come from a single-parent household, and worked my way through college to make ends meet. I’m one of few Democrats who represent a red state. In other words: **I don’t look like your typical member of Congress.** That’s something I’m proud of — but it’s also something that puts a big target on this campaign’s back. **National Republicans would rather replace me in Congress with someone who doesn’t stand out.** Someone who would be a rubber stamp to the disastrous agenda being pushed by the White House. Friend, Since last Friday, July 3rd, over 230,000 families in my community of Southeastern Michigan have been impacted by power outages—and thousands are still without power. **Our households pay some of the highest energy rates in the country while receiving some of the worst service.** The for-profit utility monopoly DTE Energy consistently raises its rates to enrich its shareholders and CEO, instead of updating urgently needed infrastructure to better serve residents. Earlier this year, **DTE Energy was fined $100 million for poisoning our air and violating the Clean Air Act. A federal judge found that they actually saved $70 million by breaking the law. What was DTE’s response? To ask for another $474 million from our pockets** , on top of the $242 million rate increase the corporation just got. **I’m fighting to lower utility bills across the country, and to guarantee access to utilities as a human right.****
****
****I will continue holding DTE accountable through policies such as the**** _Make DTE Pay Act_** , which would double Clean Air Act penalties on investor-owned utilities that request a rate hike within two years of a pollution penalty. We need to make polluting our communities as bad for business as it is for our health.

******[Will you add your name today as a grassroots co-sponsor of my _Make DTE Pay Act_ and hold greedy, polluting corporations accountable to our communities?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-d1lzvyYWiPVm2Ue_lpYBKb9fu-aumqJFOa2pJwrv-lWv1icIxyj6o31pR3yI1oHzlhBrYr5hI4Rm6K-Pw293XdRGwI01gfJVEpc96Zye4EPGgx6oimU0Q7dsNrinaGygsA1CIrxg73Cw5WE-J5gJIQcNK8ZAYa4udcBGy8mxGQaZSBn0q9OoPW1sbIvS3N0LwtDF_NTbBN028YKrFdKwFwmHoudyMO997o_X30pqO7yEm-n6FvbOEV-83FwoKclO9_PT3fauL0ROXhmdyc9LgbHv3Uo2ZsU5-YMV4H07BNfWeZoFHfHZQXi6_LYxkFBrUcqAkPhhx-D8GiA3mn0K7Aw307EVjF7J290ZaMIhmhS37Pvorjp32bd0IaC55r_jWtkXDI8ADrrYRpEsUODkTgUb3Yd-1zvo5NiVZedRM1w/4s6/f8ZYbjYzR-qji1iFPyKrfw/h1/h001.WKh13wf_zxIXUnOVpQzXQ5YYBMlXQReyob0VK39rTr0)****** | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-d1lzvyYWiPVm2Ue_lpYBKb9fu-aumqJFOa2pJwrv-lWv1icIxyj6o31pR3yI1oHzlhBrYr5hI4Rm6K-Pw293XdRGwI01gfJVEpc96Zye4EPGgx6oimU0Q7dsNrinaGyjKOIA50XC-6PbAEjp3hwgrHhez7W7SUkFSVY7E3PUmNAy4sAPix1o5hMqyFmhDxihmMtPuN8C-6cV61aVqj9srFvyIG5S26h7kiU4CwBpebuDRO6v1JAAZk19inwBtZ-yuxKRIeBE0QZu_LUJfHhtW5q3lRpJN0VOvjYiZrKzC8qXeofmG4e36YZKFR9nafTaAzidTPHNTX9kzQKmh_KoT84EiclgA_Xgisqhfow7LluJtXHbPFxxz6maDVtQa_5oiWyxDn6gGiDuwlcIH1si08GF5PwEC7FHcEkJqMReQ1Q/4s6/f8ZYbjYzR-qji1iFPyKrfw/h2/h001.IAp-9X_jPPChIx--bR6pMGJ0jyk7JyjAyAkZMl8vIXs)

**Throughout my career, I have worked alongside community members to ensure access to life-saving utilities as a human right** ―including water, electricity, internet, sanitation, and heating and cooling.
**I helped****create the nation’s first water assistance and shutoff prevention program** , securing $1.1 billion to stop water shutoffs by helping families pay their high water bills. I also introduced the **_Water Access and Affordability Act_** to create the first permanent federal water affordability program.
And I’ve introduced or championed legislation such as the **_Lowering Utility Bills Act_** , the **_Heating and Cooling Relief Act_** , the **_Maintaining Access to Essential Services Act_** , the** _Ethics in Energy Act_** , the **_UPLIFT Act_** , the **_Human Rights to Utilities Resolution_** , and of course the **_Make DTE Pay Act_**.
These policies would end utility shutoffs, make utilities public and not-for-profit, cancel utility debt, and help families pay their utility bills.
Right now, DTE is offering residents a $42 credit if their power is out for more than 96 hours. But that doesn’t even come close to making up for the spoiled food and medications in refrigerators, nor does it protect people from the heat.
**How does DTE get away with failing to invest in necessary infrastructure and poisoning our air while price-gouging customers?** In 2024, DTE donated to 120 out of 148 state lawmakers through shadow political committees. Over the years, the corporation has donated millions of dollars to shield itself from accountability. So I’m supporting state policies and a ballot initiative to ban utilities from interfering in our political system, and I’m fighting big money in politics at the federal level.
**We need to hold greedy utility monopolies accountable nationwide.** That’s why I’ve introduced the **_Make DTE Pay Act_** , which would affect not only DTE but also other U.S. investor-owned utility companies.
******[Please add your name today as a grassroots co-sponsor of my _Make DTE Pay Act_ and hold greedy, polluting corporations accountable to our communities.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-d1lzvyYWiPVm2Ue_lpYBKb9fu-aumqJFOa2pJwrv-lWv1icIxyj6o31pR3yI1oHzlhBrYr5hI4Rm6K-Pw293XdRGwI01gfJVEpc96Zye4EPGgx6oimU0Q7dsNrinaGyhuYo3E215_shyKx31rv9dhfYVvu2mTWHEpkOuP164fEL9PBD9iiY1YIMgpAaPu0tDCqvAss2xtzOvMiB_xH-ILHcsSL7G4_gOIgjX1FSVghtwfdhDt8uX_94yX72HOto9gdXhcvj-5mYj3snFfJ_S1O-4hY0SlU7L7OgR7KvzEZ6UBVBMpJC_lZs6AV3KIU-eYagCvs2l9uWsgq953LOEbg2VPdPNqxICja22hFDnPTzlu72fPO0b6BuicbQhgYh32BLkOA2stvXhWW2CW7da2HEisXe0goDmInFV87m1-Xg/4s6/f8ZYbjYzR-qji1iFPyKrfw/h3/h001.KflOFbux7dF9i_h8j-HOaDebSePGHr6VtzEEvm-ZisI)******
I grew up in the shadows of corporate polluters where we have the highest rates of asthma in the country. That’s what drove me to become an environmental justice advocate many years ago, and it’s why I helped co-found the new People’s Environmental Justice Caucus in Congress―to protect our right to clean air and water, and protect our communities from greedy corporate polluters that profit at the expense of our health and our climate.
I’ll continue pushing for people over profits, including with legislation like the _Stop Price Gouging in Grocery Stores Act_ , the _Stop AI Price Gouging and Wage Fixing Act_ , and the Dignity for All package of bills to put money in every family’s pockets.
Together we’ll continue building a society where everyone can access clean air and water, affordable energy, and other rights such as quality healthcare and housing. We are powerful together.
Always serving you,
Rashida

clean_body: Our households pay some of the highest energy rates in the country while receiving some of the worst service. | | | Friend, Since last Friday, July 3rd, over 230,000 families in my community of Southeastern Michigan have been impacted by power outages—and thousands are still without power. Our households pay some of the highest energy rates in the country while receiving some of the worst service. The for-profit utility monopoly DTE Energy consistently raises its rates to enrich its shareholders and CEO, instead of updating urgently needed infrastructure to better serve residents. Earlier this year, DTE Energy was fined $100 million for poisoning our air and violating the Clean Air Act. A federal judge found that they actually saved $70 million by breaking the law. What was DTE’s response? To ask for another $474 million from our pockets , on top of the $242 million rate increase the corporation just got. I’m fighting to lower utility bills across the country, and to guarantee access to utilities as a human right. I will continue holding DTE accountable through policies such as the Make DTE Pay Act , which would double Clean Air Act penalties on investor-owned utilities that request a rate hike within two years of a pollution penalty. We need to make polluting our communities as bad for business as it is for our health. ****** | Throughout my career, I have worked alongside community members to ensure access to life-saving utilities as a human right ―including water, electricity, internet, sanitation, and heating and cooling. I helped**create the nation’s first water assistance and shutoff prevention program , securing $1.1 billion to stop water shutoffs by helping families pay their high water bills. I also introduced the Water Access and Affordability Act to create the first permanent federal water affordability program. And I’ve introduced or championed legislation such as the Lowering Utility Bills Act , the Heating and Cooling Relief Act , the Maintaining Access to Essential Services Act , the Ethics in Energy Act , the UPLIFT Act , the Human Rights to Utilities Resolution , and of course the Make DTE Pay Act. These policies would end utility shutoffs, make utilities public and not-for-profit, cancel utility debt, and help families pay their utility bills. Right now, DTE is offering residents a $42 credit if their power is out for more than 96 hours. But that doesn’t even come close to making up for the spoiled food and medications in refrigerators, nor does it protect people from the heat. How does DTE get away with failing to invest in necessary infrastructure and poisoning our air while price-gouging customers? In 2024, DTE donated to 120 out of 148 state lawmakers through shadow political committees. Over the years, the corporation has donated millions of dollars to shield itself from accountability. So I’m supporting state policies and a ballot initiative to ban utilities from interfering in our political system, and I’m fighting big money in politics at the federal level. We need to hold greedy utility monopolies accountable nationwide. That’s why I’ve introduced the Make DTE Pay Act , which would affect not only DTE but also other U.S. investor-owned utility companies. ****** I grew up in the shadows of corporate polluters where we have the highest rates of asthma in the country. That’s what drove me to become an environmental justice advocate many years ago, and it’s why I helped co-found the new People’s Environmental Justice Caucus in Congress―to protect our right to clean air and water, and protect our communities from greedy corporate polluters that profit at the expense of our health and our climate. I’ll continue pushing for people over profits, including with legislation like the Stop Price Gouging in Grocery Stores Act , the Stop AI Price Gouging and Wage Fixing Act , and the Dignity for All package of bills to put money in every family’s pockets. Together we’ll continue building a society where everyone can access clean air and water, affordable energy, and other rights such as quality healthcare and housing. We are powerful together. Some weeks the news writes its own punchline, and this was one of them. On this episode of Amped Up, [Cliff Schecter](https://open.substack.com/users/31941177-cliff-schecter?utm_source=mentions) and [David Shuster](https://open.substack.com/users/16891317-david-shuster?utm_source=mentions) pull up their chairs--with [Lawrence Winnerman](https://open.substack.com/users/314034871-lawrence-winnerman?utm_source=mentions) along for the ride--and watch a president narrate his own unraveling on the world stage, one mangled acronym and invented country at a time.
There is a war being restarted, a ceasefire torn up within weeks of the handshake, and a corporate press still reaching for the both-sides life raft. We are not going to tell you which moment made the guys put their heads in their hands. You will want to see it for yourself.
From there it only gets richer. A Senate nominee whose campaign is coming apart at exactly the wrong moment. A Texas attorney general whose airport photo op raises more questions than his indictments ever did. A World Cup run that a certain someone found a way to make about himself, right up until an entire locker room danced back.
And then the turn nobody expects: a genuinely hopeful read on Ukraine, on Zelensky, and on what leadership actually looks like when the test finally comes. It is funny, it is furious, and it lands somewhere you will not see coming.
Hit play.

Now, let's win in November.
Jena Griswold

They can't own a firearm. Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life -- law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions. **About Rebecca**
Rebecca Bennett has spent her life answering the call to serve.
She served our country for more than fifteen years as a Navy helicopter pilot, aircraft commander, and officer in the Air National Guard.
She’s a mom of two young girls who understands firsthand what families are up against right now: rising costs, the struggle to balance work and family, and the feeling that Washington is not focused on making life easier for the people it is supposed to serve.
That kind of servant leadership is exactly what we need more of in Congress. It’s why I’m proud to endorse Rebecca’s campaign for Congress in New Jersey’s 7th District.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134963332/632730895/304274175?refcode=b26_em_fr_2026.07.09_b1_prhq_exp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85OTAyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzM0YTk3My1lNjdiLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oJXixTFz3drYalAy67SYM6PqnsT6BEq7_XLEMxbzzkA=)
**NJ-7: A true toss-up we need to win**
Control of the House could come down to NJ-7. Tom Kean Jr. won NJ-7 by less than five points in 2024, and Rebecca has one of the best chances in the entire country of flipping a red seat blue.
I know what it takes to win in a tough congressional district. It takes discipline, trust, and a candidate who understands that public service is not about chasing headlines or pleasing party bosses. It is about showing up, doing the work, and fighting for the people you represent.
Rebecca has what it takes to win.
**Why I’m supporting Rebecca**
Rebecca’s campaign is rooted in the same values I believe in: service, patriotism, accountability, and results.
She has served our country in uniform. She has worked in health care. She is raising a family. And she understands the challenges families are facing because she has lived them herself.
Washington has too many politicians who talk a big game about patriotism but forget what patriotism actually means: serving the people, protecting our democracy, standing up for veterans and servicemembers, and making life better for working families.
Rebecca will bring common sense, integrity, and real-life experience to Congress. She is the kind of leader we need in this fight, and I know she will be ready on day one.
**Building the Patriotic Majority**
My support for Rebecca is also part of a larger mission.
I started Patriot PAC because I believe our country needs a new generation of leaders rooted in service, patriotism, and community. Veterans. Public servants. Teachers. First responders. People who have spent their lives serving our country.
The path forward for Democrats isn't about fitting into one ideological box. It's about putting forward leaders who understand sacrifice, know how to solve problems, and are willing to fight for us.
Rebecca has spent her life serving our country, and she embodies exactly the kind of leadership I want Patriot PAC to help elect across New York and across America.
Together, we're building a patriotic majority.

Your support will help elect service-oriented leaders in critical battleground races and continue growing a movement built on service, patriotism, and results.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134963333/632730896/304274175?refcode=b26_em_fr_2026.07.09_b1_prhq_exp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85OTAyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzM0YTk3My1lNjdiLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oJXixTFz3drYalAy67SYM6PqnsT6BEq7_XLEMxbzzkA=)

Fellow Conservative,

$103 million

That's how much George Soros and his son Alex have already poured into this midterm cycle — and they're not done. Soros previously set the record for midterm spending at $128 million, and by all accounts, he's on track to blow past it.

This isn't some grassroots movement. It's one family with a fortune trying to buy the United States Senate for the Democrats.

Holding President Trump’s Senate majority comes down to a small handful of races — and three of the most important are happening right now in **Ohio, Alaska, and Montana.**

Lose any of them, and Chuck Schumer takes the gavel.

And make no mistake about what that means. Schumer will go after election integrity laws, pack the Supreme Court with liberal judges, make DC a state to expand his power, and ram through every radical priority the left has been dreaming about for years — all bankrolled by Soros' money.

**I won’t let that happen without a fight.**

The only way we stop Schumer is by ensuring conservative fighters in key Senate races across the country win. **President Trump has given all three patriots in Ohio, Alaska, and Montana his complete and total endorsement:**

Mission Regional Medical Center is under scrutiny after it was discovered the hospital was running billboard ads in Spanish that advertised "Birth Packages in South Texas."
The hospital is located in Mission, Texas, which is very close to the United States-Mexico border. What was notable is that billboards directed customers to a telephone number that started with "001," the country code used to place calls to the United States from Mexico. Even more damning was the website, "havemybabyinTEXAS.com."
**[The "Birth Packages"](https://substack.com/redirect/fa97faec-ec63-4f87-b9d9-cfc0f2748e2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** were $3,950 for a natural birth and $5,525 for a C-section.
The center denied any wrongdoing, saying they have taken down the billboards and the "havemybabyinTexas" website no longer works.

It’s time to raise hell, and send Democrats to Congress who will do what the Republicans won’t: Tell Trump no.
#
Peter,
The National Capital Planning Commission met today to vote on the Arc de Trump.
The commission, historically, is a body meant to steward our nation’s history, our monuments and memorials, and to pursue projects that unify and provide meaning to our shared experience as Americans.
If you took a look at any of the public comments submitted to the commission about the arch, you’d see that they were overwhelmingly — almost entirely — in opposition. And if you tuned in to the livestream of the meeting, you would have heard that virtually all public testimony on the arch was, again, in opposition.
But Trump’s appointees don’t care about the purpose of the commission, or what the public thinks. They’re going to do what Trump tells them to do. They’re going to force this arch through as fast as they can — even if they need to make “structural revisions,” which is where they ended up today.
It’s going to take more than a good argument to stop this thing. It’s time to raise hell, and send Democrats to Congress who will do what the Republicans won’t: Tell Trump no.
We can stop this arch. But to do it, we need to win majorities in the House and Senate. And VoteVets is ready to invest millions of dollars to make that happen.

subject: I want to share something with you, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
The people who love our nation enough to change it.
#
Peter,
**Recently, the Ellis Island Honors Society recognized me, alongside several distinguished naturalized U.S. citizens, for our contributions to America.**
Standing there gave me a profound moment to reflect on what it truly means to be an American as our nation marks its historic 250th anniversary, and why we find ourselves at a critical crossroads for the next 250 years.
I want to share what this milestone means for the future of our democracy and the community we serve, but first:
[**Will you pitch in $3 to Voto Latino today to help us empower the next generation of voters and shape the next 250?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260709-1.t4Tha2&amount=3&refcode=em20260709-357&t=1&akid=357%2E1366028%2E3ta1ct)
To be recognized at this historic milestone is a deep honor. I stood there, proud to be on that stage, because of my mother’s courage and grit. A woman who deferred her own dreams so that I could realize mine. As a naturalized American, I don't just believe in the American Dream. I feel a sacred responsibility to protect it.
Our nation's history is a complex weave, marked by failures but also by immense human achievements. Since our inception, we have debated who gets to belong in this country. Yet, time and again, brave individuals have challenged us to expand our understanding and forge paths toward equity and justice. America isn’t an accident of history — it’s an intentional choice.
Our true superpower is our diversity of people, creed, and thought. The promise of America was never meant to be a static document frozen in 1776. It is a living, breathing experiment in human possibility, where people from every corner of the earth come together to weave a shared tapestry and design a more just world.
**That is why I refuse to let the darkness of our current political climate obscure the brilliant future right in front of us.**
The current backlash, the relentless voter suppression, and the legal assaults do not exist because we are weak. They exist _precisely_ because we are winning.
Those trying to suppress our voices are fighting a losing battle against math, time, and destiny. They’re terrified because they see a new generation standing up, unapologetically defending the true American ideals of equality, freedom, and mutual care.
For me, this fight is deeply personal. Hostile courts mean my own children are growing up today with fewer rights than I had. But they are also growing up as part of the largest, most fluid, multiracial demographic this nation has ever seen. When young Latinos show up, we don’t just participate in the political landscape — we completely transform it.
Millions of young Latino Americans are entering the electorate right now. Young, fierce, hungry to participate, and ready to protect their families. They know exactly what is at stake, and they are ready to claim their agency at the ballot box.
The numbers, the passion, and the moral arc of history are squarely on our side. The promise of America belongs to the people who love her enough to change her for the better. It’s time to lead, claim our power, and fulfill that promise together.
**[Peter, will you pitch in $3 right now to support Voto Latino and build a future that reflects all of us?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260709-1.t4Tha2&amount=3&refcode=em20260709-357&t=2&akid=357%2E1366028%2E3ta1ct)**
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260709-1.t4Tha2&amount=3&refcode=20260709-357&t=21&akid=357%2E1366028%2E3ta1ct)**
Thank you for reading,
Maria Teresa Kumar
Co-founder and CEO, Voto Latino

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-voto-footer?refcode=em20260709-357-&t=22&refcode2=357_1366028_3ta1ct&akid=357%2E1366028%2E3ta1ct)**
---
